translations.kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
translations.ylt: Seeing that many did take in hand to set in order a narration of the matters that have been fully assured among us,
translations.web: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

translations.kjv: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
translations.ylt: as they did deliver to us, who from the beginning became eye-witnesses, and officers of the Word, --
translations.web: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

translations.kjv: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
translations.ylt: it seemed good also to me, having followed from the first after all things exactly, to write to thee in order, most noble Theophilus,
translations.web: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

translations.kjv: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
translations.ylt: that thou mayest know the certainty of the things wherein thou wast instructed.
translations.web: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

translations.kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
translations.ylt: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest, by name Zacharias, of the course of Abijah, and his wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name Elisabeth;
translations.web: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

translations.kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
translations.ylt: and they were both righteous before God, going on in all the commands and righteousnesses of the Lord blameless,
translations.web: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

translations.kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
translations.ylt: and they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and both were advanced in their days.
translations.web: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in his acting as priest, in the order of his course before God,
translations.web: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

translations.kjv: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
translations.ylt: according to the custom of the priesthood, his lot was to make perfume, having gone into the sanctuary of the Lord,
translations.web: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

translations.kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
translations.ylt: and all the multitude of the people were praying without, at the hour of the perfume.
translations.web: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

translations.kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
translations.ylt: And there appeared to him a messenger of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of the perfume,
translations.web: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

translations.kjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
translations.ylt: and Zacharias, having seen, was troubled, and fear fell on him;
translations.web: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

translations.kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
translations.ylt: and the messenger said unto him, `Fear not, Zacharias, for thy supplication was heard, and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear a son to thee, and thou shalt call his name John,
translations.web: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

translations.kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
translations.ylt: and there shall be joy to thee, and gladness, and many at his birth shall joy,
translations.web: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

translations.kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.
translations.ylt: for he shall be great before the Lord, and wine and strong drink he may not drink, and of the Holy Spirit he shall be full, even from his mother's womb;
translations.web: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

translations.kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
translations.ylt: and many of the sons of Israel he shall turn to the Lord their God,
translations.web: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

translations.kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
translations.ylt: and he shall go before Him, in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn hearts of fathers unto children, and disobedient ones to the wisdom of righteous ones, to make ready for the Lord, a people prepared.'
translations.web: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

translations.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
translations.ylt: And Zacharias said unto the messenger, `Whereby shall I know this? for I am aged, and my wife is advanced in her days?'
translations.web: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

translations.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
translations.ylt: And the messenger answering said to him, `I am Gabriel, who have been standing near before God, and I was sent to speak unto thee, and to proclaim these good news to thee,
translations.web: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

translations.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
translations.ylt: and lo, thou shalt be silent, and not able to speak, till the day that these things shall come to pass, because thou didst not believe my words, that shall be fulfilled in their season.'
translations.web: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

translations.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
translations.ylt: And the people were waiting for Zacharias, and wondering at his tarrying in the sanctuary,
translations.web: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

translations.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
translations.ylt: and having come out, he was not able to speak to them, and they perceived that a vision he had seen in the sanctuary, and he was beckoning to them, and did remain dumb.
translations.web: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, when the days of his service were fulfilled, he went away to his house,
translations.web: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

translations.kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
translations.ylt: and after those days, his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying--
translations.web: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

translations.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
translations.ylt: `Thus hath the Lord done to me, in days in which He looked upon me, to take away my reproach among men.'
translations.web: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

translations.kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
translations.ylt: And in the sixth month was the messenger Gabriel sent by God, to a city of Galilee, the name of which is Nazareth,
translations.web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

translations.kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.
translations.ylt: to a virgin, betrothed to a man, whose name is Joseph, of the house of David, and the name of the virgin is Mary.
translations.web: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

translations.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
translations.ylt: And the messenger having come in unto her, said, `Hail, favoured one, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women;'
translations.web: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

translations.kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
translations.ylt: and she, having seen, was troubled at his word, and was reasoning of what kind this salutation may be.
translations.web: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

translations.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
translations.ylt: And the messenger said to her, `Fear not, Mary, for thou hast found favour with God;
translations.web: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

translations.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
translations.ylt: and lo, thou shalt conceive in the womb, and shalt bring forth a son, and call his name Jesus;
translations.web: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

translations.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
translations.ylt: he shall be great, and Son of the Highest he shall be called, and the Lord God shall give him the throne of David his father,
translations.web: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

translations.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
translations.ylt: and he shall reign over the house of Jacob to the ages; and of his reign there shall be no end.'
translations.web: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
translations.ylt: And Mary said unto the messenger, `How shall this be, seeing a husband I do not know?'
translations.web: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

translations.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
translations.ylt: And the messenger answering said to her, `The Holy Spirit shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee, therefore also the holy-begotten thing shall be called Son of God;
translations.web: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

translations.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
translations.ylt: and lo, Elisabeth, thy kinswoman, she also hath conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month to her who was called barren;
translations.web: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

translations.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
translations.ylt: because nothing shall be impossible with God.'
translations.web: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

translations.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
translations.ylt: And Mary said, `Lo, the maid-servant of the Lord; let it be to me according to thy saying,' and the messenger went away from her.
translations.web: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

translations.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
translations.ylt: And Mary having arisen in those days, went to the hill-country, with haste, to a city of Judea,
translations.web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

translations.kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
translations.ylt: and entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
translations.web: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe did leap in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit,
translations.web: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
translations.ylt: and spake out with a loud voice, and said, `Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb;
translations.web: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

translations.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
translations.ylt: and whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord might come unto me?
translations.web: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

translations.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
translations.ylt: for, lo, when the voice of thy salutation came to my ears, leap in gladness did the babe in my womb;
translations.web: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

translations.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
translations.ylt: and happy is she who did believe, for there shall be a completion to the things spoken to her from the Lord.'
translations.web: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

translations.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
translations.ylt: And Mary said, `My soul doth magnify the Lord,
translations.web: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

translations.kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
translations.ylt: And my spirit was glad on God my Saviour,
translations.web: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

translations.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
translations.ylt: Because He looked on the lowliness of His maid-servant, For, lo, henceforth call me happy shall all the generations,
translations.web: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

translations.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
translations.ylt: For He who is mighty did to me great things, And holy is His name,
translations.web: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

translations.kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
translations.ylt: And His kindness is to generations of generations, To those fearing Him,
translations.web: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

translations.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
translations.ylt: He did powerfully with His arm, He scattered abroad the proud in the thought of their heart,
translations.web: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

translations.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
translations.ylt: He brought down the mighty from thrones, And He exalted the lowly,
translations.web: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

translations.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
translations.ylt: The hungry He did fill with good, And the rich He sent away empty,
translations.web: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

translations.kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
translations.ylt: He received again Israel His servant, To remember kindness,
translations.web: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

translations.kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
translations.ylt: As He spake unto our fathers, To Abraham and to his seed--to the age.'
translations.web: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

translations.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
translations.ylt: And Mary remained with her about three months, and turned back to her house.
translations.web: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

translations.kjv: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
translations.ylt: And to Elisabeth was the time fulfilled for her bringing forth, and she bare a son,
translations.web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

translations.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
translations.ylt: and the neighbours and her kindred heard that the Lord was making His kindness great with her, and they were rejoicing with her.
translations.web: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, on the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child, and they were calling him by the name of his father, Zacharias,
translations.web: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

translations.kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
translations.ylt: and his mother answering said, `No, but he shall be called John.'
translations.web: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

translations.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
translations.ylt: And they said unto her--`There is none among thy kindred who is called by this name,'
translations.web: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

translations.kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
translations.ylt: and they were making signs to his father, what he would wish him to be called,
translations.web: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

translations.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
translations.ylt: and having asked for a tablet, he wrote, saying, `John is his name;' and they did all wonder;
translations.web: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

translations.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
translations.ylt: and his mouth was opened presently, and his tongue, and he was speaking, praising God.
translations.web: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

translations.kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judea.
translations.ylt: And fear came upon all those dwelling around them, and in all the hill-country of Judea were all these sayings spoken of,
translations.web: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

translations.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
translations.ylt: and all who heard did lay them up in their hearts, saying, `What then shall this child be?' and the hand of the Lord was with him.
translations.web: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

translations.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
translations.ylt: And Zacharias his father was filled with the Holy Spirit, and did prophesy, saying,
translations.web: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

translations.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
translations.ylt: `Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel, Because He did look upon, And wrought redemption for His people,
translations.web: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

translations.kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
translations.ylt: And did raise an horn of salvation to us, In the house of David His servant,
translations.web: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

translations.kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
translations.ylt: As He spake by the mouth of His holy prophets, Which have been from the age;
translations.web: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

translations.kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
translations.ylt: Salvation from our enemies, And out of the hand of all hating us,
translations.web: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

translations.kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
translations.ylt: To do kindness with our fathers, And to be mindful of His holy covenant,
translations.web: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

translations.kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
translations.ylt: An oath that He sware to Abraham our father,
translations.web: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

translations.kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
translations.ylt: To give to us, without fear, Out of the hand of our enemies having been delivered,
translations.web: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

translations.kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
translations.ylt: To serve Him, in holiness and righteousness Before Him, all the days of our life.
translations.web: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

translations.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
translations.ylt: And thou, child, Prophet of the Highest Shalt thou be called; For thou shalt go before the face of the Lord, To prepare His ways.
translations.web: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

translations.kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
translations.ylt: To give knowledge of salvation to His people In remission of their sins,
translations.web: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

translations.kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
translations.ylt: Through the tender mercies of our God, In which the rising from on high did look upon us,
translations.web: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

translations.kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
translations.ylt: To give light to those sitting in darkness and death-shade, To guide our feet to a way of peace.'
translations.web: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

translations.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
translations.ylt: And the child grew, and was strengthened in spirit, and he was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
translations.web: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass in those days, there went forth a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world be enrolled--
translations.web: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

translations.kjv: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
translations.ylt: this enrolment first came to pass when Cyrenius was governor of Syria--
translations.web: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

translations.kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
translations.ylt: and all were going to be enrolled, each to his proper city,
translations.web: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

translations.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
translations.ylt: and Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, to Judea, to the city of David, that is called Bethlehem, because of his being of the house and family of David,
translations.web: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

translations.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
translations.ylt: to enrol himself with Mary his betrothed wife, being with child.
translations.web: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

translations.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in their being there, the days were fulfilled for her bringing forth,
translations.web: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

translations.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
translations.ylt: and she brought forth her son--the first-born, and wrapped him up, and laid him down in the manger, because there was not for them a place in the guest-chamber.
translations.web: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

translations.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
translations.ylt: And there were shepherds in the same region, lodging in the field, and keeping the night-watches over their flock,
translations.web: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

translations.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
translations.ylt: and lo, a messenger of the Lord stood over them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they feared a great fear.
translations.web: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

translations.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
translations.ylt: And the messenger said to them, `Fear not, for lo, I bring you good news of great joy, that shall be to all the people--
translations.web: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

translations.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
translations.ylt: because there was born to you to-day a Saviour--who is Christ the Lord--in the city of David,
translations.web: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

translations.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
translations.ylt: and this is to you the sign: Ye shall find a babe wrapped up, lying in the manger.'
translations.web: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

translations.kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
translations.ylt: And suddenly there came with the messenger a multitude of the heavenly host, praising God, and saying,
translations.web: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

translations.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
translations.ylt: `Glory in the highest to God, and upon earth peace, among men--good will.'
translations.web: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, when the messengers were gone away from them to the heavens, that the men, the shepherds, said unto one another, `We may go over indeed unto Bethlehem, and see this thing that hath come to pass, that the Lord did make known to us.'
translations.web: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

translations.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
translations.ylt: And they came, having hasted, and found both Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in the manger,
translations.web: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

translations.kjv: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
translations.ylt: and having seen, they made known abroad concerning the saying spoken to them concerning the child.
translations.web: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

translations.kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
translations.ylt: And all who heard, did wonder concerning the things spoken by the shepherds unto them;
translations.web: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

translations.kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
translations.ylt: and Mary was preserving all these things, pondering in her heart;
translations.web: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

translations.kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
translations.ylt: and the shepherds turned back, glorifying and praising God, for all those things they heard and saw, as it was spoken unto them.
translations.web: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

translations.kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
translations.ylt: And when eight days were fulfilled to circumcise the child, then was his name called Jesus, having been so called by the messenger before his being conceived in the womb.
translations.web: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

translations.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
translations.ylt: And when the days of their purification were fulfilled, according to the law of Moses, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present to the Lord,
translations.web: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

translations.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
translations.ylt: as it hath been written in the Law of the Lord, --`Every male opening a womb shall be called holy to the Lord,'
translations.web: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

translations.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
translations.ylt: and to give a sacrifice, according to that said in the Law of the Lord, `A pair of turtle-doves, or two young pigeons.'
translations.web: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
translations.ylt: And lo, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name is Simeon, and this man is righteous and devout, looking for the comforting of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him,
translations.web: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

translations.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
translations.ylt: and it hath been divinely told him by the Holy Spirit--not to see death before he may see the Christ of the Lord.
translations.web: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

translations.kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
translations.ylt: And he came in the Spirit to the temple, and in the parents bringing in the child Jesus, for their doing according to the custom of the law regarding him,
translations.web: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

translations.kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
translations.ylt: then he took him in his arms, and blessed God, and he said,
translations.web: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

translations.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
translations.ylt: `Now Thou dost send away Thy servant, Lord, according to Thy word, in peace,
translations.web: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

translations.kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
translations.ylt: because mine eyes did see Thy salvation,
translations.web: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

translations.kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
translations.ylt: which Thou didst prepare before the face of all the peoples,
translations.web: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

translations.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
translations.ylt: a light to the uncovering of nations, and the glory of Thy people Israel.'
translations.web: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

translations.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
translations.ylt: And Joseph and his mother were wondering at the things spoken concerning him,
translations.web: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

translations.kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
translations.ylt: and Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, `Lo, this one is set for the falling and rising again of many in Israel, and for a sign spoken against--
translations.web: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

translations.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
translations.ylt: (and also thine own soul shall a sword pass through) --that the reasonings of many hearts may be revealed.'
translations.web: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

translations.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
translations.ylt: And there was Anna, a prophetess, daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, she was much advanced in days, having lived with an husband seven years from her virginity,
translations.web: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

translations.kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
translations.ylt: and she is a widow of about eighty-four years, who did depart not from the temple, with fasts and supplications serving, night and day,
translations.web: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

translations.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: and she, at that hour, having come in, was confessing, likewise, to the Lord, and was speaking concerning him, to all those looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
translations.web: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
translations.ylt: And when they finished all things, according to the Law of the Lord, they turned back to Galilee, to their city Nazareth;
translations.web: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

translations.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
translations.ylt: and the child grew and was strengthened in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
translations.web: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

translations.kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
translations.ylt: And his parents were going yearly to Jerusalem, at the feast of the passover,
translations.web: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

translations.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
translations.ylt: and when he became twelve years old, they having gone up to Jerusalem, according to the custom of the feast,
translations.web: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

translations.kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
translations.ylt: and having finished the days, in their returning the child Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, and Joseph and his mother did not know,
translations.web: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

translations.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
translations.ylt: and, having supposed him to be in the company, they went a day's journey, and were seeking him among the kindred and among the acquaintances,
translations.web: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

translations.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
translations.ylt: and not having found him, they turned back to Jerusalem seeking him.
translations.web: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, after three days, they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them and questioning them,
translations.web: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

translations.kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
translations.ylt: and all those hearing him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
translations.web: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

translations.kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
translations.ylt: And, having seen him, they were amazed, and his mother said unto him, `Child, why didst thou thus to us? lo, thy father and I, sorrowing, were seeking thee.'
translations.web: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `Why is it that ye were seeking me? did ye not know that in the things of my Father it behoveth me to be?'
translations.web: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

translations.kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
translations.ylt: and they did not understand the saying that he spake to them,
translations.web: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

translations.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
translations.ylt: and he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and he was subject to them, and his mother was keeping all these sayings in her heart,
translations.web: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

translations.kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
translations.ylt: and Jesus was advancing in wisdom, and in stature, and in favour with God and men.
translations.web: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

translations.kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
translations.ylt: And in the fifteenth year of the government of Tiberius Caesar--Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod tetrarch of Galilee, and Philip his brother, tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene--
translations.web: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

translations.kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
translations.ylt: Annas and Caiaphas being chief priests--there came a word of God unto John the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness,
translations.web: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

translations.kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
translations.ylt: and he came to all the region round the Jordan, proclaiming a baptism of reformation--to remission of sins,
translations.web: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

translations.kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
translations.ylt: as it hath been written in the scroll of the words of Isaiah the prophet, saying, `A voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, straight make ye His paths;
translations.web: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

translations.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
translations.ylt: every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be made low, and the crooked shall become straightness, and the rough become smooth ways;
translations.web: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

translations.kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
translations.ylt: and all flesh shall see the salvation of God.'
translations.web: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

translations.kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
translations.ylt: Then said he to the multitudes coming forth to be baptised by him, `Brood of vipers! who did prompt you to flee from the coming wrath?
translations.web: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

translations.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
translations.ylt: make, therefore, fruits worthy of the reformation, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have a father--Abraham; for I say to you, that God is able out of these stones to raise children to Abraham;
translations.web: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

translations.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
translations.ylt: and already also the axe unto the root of the trees is laid, every tree, therefore, not making good fruit is cut down, and to fire it is cast.'
translations.web: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

translations.kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
translations.ylt: And the multitudes were questioning him, saying, `What, then, shall we do?'
translations.web: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

translations.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
translations.ylt: and he answering saith to them, `He having two coats--let him impart to him having none, and he having victuals--in like manner let him do.'
translations.web: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

translations.kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
translations.ylt: And there came also tax-gatherers to be baptised, and they said unto him, `Teacher, what shall we do?'
translations.web: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
translations.ylt: and he said unto them, `Exact no more than that directed you.'
translations.web: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

translations.kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
translations.ylt: And questioning him also were those warring, saying, `And we, what shall we do?' and he said unto them, `Do violence to no one, nor accuse falsely, and be content with your wages.'
translations.web: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

translations.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
translations.ylt: And the people are looking forward, and all are reasoning in their hearts concerning John, whether or not he may be the Christ;
translations.web: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

translations.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
translations.ylt: John answered, saying to all, `I indeed with water do baptise you, but he cometh who is mightier than I, of whom I am not worthy to loose the latchet of his sandals--he shall baptise you with the Holy Spirit and with fire;
translations.web: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

translations.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
translations.ylt: whose winnowing shovel is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his floor, and will gather the wheat to his storehouse, and the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.'
translations.web: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

translations.kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
translations.ylt: And, therefore, indeed with many other things, exhorting, he was proclaiming good news to the people,
translations.web: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

translations.kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
translations.ylt: and Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him concerning Herodias the wife of Philip his brother, and concerning all the evils that Herod did,
translations.web: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

translations.kjv: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
translations.ylt: added also this to all, that he shut up John in the prison.
translations.web: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

translations.kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in all the people being baptised, Jesus also being baptised, and praying, the heaven was opened,
translations.web: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

translations.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
translations.ylt: and the Holy Spirit came down in a bodily appearance, as if a dove, upon him, and a voice came out of heaven, saying, `Thou art My Son--the Beloved, in thee I did delight.'
translations.web: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
translations.ylt: And Jesus himself was beginning to be about thirty years of age, being, as was supposed, son of Joseph,
translations.web: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
translations.ylt: the son of Eli, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Janna, the son of Joseph,
translations.web: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
translations.ylt: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Naum, the son of Esli,
translations.web: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
translations.ylt: the son of Naggai, the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semei, the son of Joseph, the son of Juda,
translations.web: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
translations.ylt: the son of Joanna, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel,
translations.web: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
translations.ylt: the son of Neri, the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
translations.web: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
translations.ylt: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat,
translations.web: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
translations.ylt: the son of Levi, the son of Simeon, the son of Juda, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
translations.web: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
translations.ylt: the son of Melea, the son of Mainan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan,
translations.web: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
translations.ylt: the son of David, the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Booz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
translations.web: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
translations.ylt: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Esrom, the son of Pharez,
translations.web: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
translations.ylt: the son of Judah, the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
translations.web: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
translations.ylt: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber,
translations.web: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
translations.ylt: the son of Salah, the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
translations.web: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
translations.ylt: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel,
translations.web: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

translations.kjv: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
translations.ylt: the son of Cainan, the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
translations.web: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

translations.kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
translations.ylt: And Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, turned back from the Jordan, and was brought in the Spirit to the wilderness,
translations.web: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

translations.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
translations.ylt: forty days being tempted by the Devil, and he did not eat anything in those days, and they having been ended, he afterward hungered,
translations.web: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

translations.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
translations.ylt: and the Devil said to him, `If Son thou art of God, speak to this stone that it may become bread.'
translations.web: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answered him, saying, `It hath been written, that, not on bread only shall man live, but on every saying of God.'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

translations.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
translations.ylt: And the Devil having brought him up to an high mountain, shewed to him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time,
translations.web: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

translations.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
translations.ylt: and the Devil said to him, `To thee I will give all this authority, and their glory, because to me it hath been delivered, and to whomsoever I will, I do give it;
translations.web: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

translations.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
translations.ylt: thou, then, if thou mayest bow before me--all shall be thine.'
translations.web: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering him said, `Get thee behind me, Adversary, for it hath been written, Thou shalt bow before the Lord thy God, and Him only thou shalt serve.'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

translations.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
translations.ylt: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, `If the Son thou art of God, cast thyself down hence,
translations.web: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

translations.kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
translations.ylt: for it hath been written--To His messengers He will give charge concerning thee, to guard over thee,
translations.web: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

translations.kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
translations.ylt: and--On hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou mayest dash against a stone thy foot.'
translations.web: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to him--`It hath been said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.'
translations.web: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

translations.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
translations.ylt: And having ended all temptation, the Devil departed from him till a convenient season.
translations.web: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

translations.kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
translations.ylt: And Jesus turned back in the power of the Spirit to Galilee, and a fame went forth through all the region round about concerning him,
translations.web: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

translations.kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
translations.ylt: and he was teaching in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
translations.web: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

translations.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
translations.ylt: And he came to Nazareth, where he hath been brought up, and he went in, according to his custom, on the sabbath-day, to the synagogue, and stood up to read;
translations.web: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

translations.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
translations.ylt: and there was given over to him a roll of Isaiah the prophet, and having unfolded the roll, he found the place where it hath been written:
translations.web: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

translations.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
translations.ylt: `The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, Because He did anoint me; To proclaim good news to the poor, Sent me to heal the broken of heart, To proclaim to captives deliverance, And to blind receiving of sight, To send away the bruised with deliverance,
translations.web: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

translations.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
translations.ylt: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.'
translations.web: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

translations.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
translations.ylt: And having folded the roll, having given it back to the officer, he sat down, and the eyes of all in the synagogue were gazing on him.
translations.web: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

translations.kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
translations.ylt: And he began to say unto them--`To-day hath this writing been fulfilled in your ears;'
translations.web: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

translations.kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?
translations.ylt: and all were bearing testimony to him, and were wondering at the gracious words that are coming forth out of his mouth, and they said, `Is not this the son of Joseph?'
translations.web: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `Certainly ye will say to me this simile, Physician, heal thyself; as great things as we heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country;'
translations.web: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

translations.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
translations.ylt: and he said, `Verily I say to you--No prophet is accepted in his own country;
translations.web: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

translations.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
translations.ylt: and of a truth I say to you, Many widows were in the days of Elijah, in Israel, when the heaven was shut for three years and six months, when great famine came on all the land,
translations.web: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

translations.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
translations.ylt: and unto none of them was Elijah sent, but--to Sarepta of Sidon, unto a woman, a widow;
translations.web: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

translations.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
translations.ylt: and many lepers were in the time of Elisha the prophet, in Israel, and none of them was cleansed, but--Naaman the Syrian.'
translations.web: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

translations.kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
translations.ylt: And all in the synagogue were filled with wrath, hearing these things,
translations.web: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

translations.kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
translations.ylt: and having risen, they put him forth without the city, and brought him unto the brow of the hill on which their city had been built--to cast him down headlong,
translations.web: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

translations.kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
translations.ylt: and he, having gone through the midst of them, went away.
translations.web: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

translations.kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
translations.ylt: And he came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and was teaching them on the sabbaths,
translations.web: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

translations.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
translations.ylt: and they were astonished at his teaching, because his word was with authority.
translations.web: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

translations.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
translations.ylt: And in the synagogue was a man, having a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a great voice,
translations.web: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

translations.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
translations.ylt: saying, `Away, what--to us and to thee, Jesus, O Nazarene? thou didst come to destroy us; I have known thee who thou art--the Holy One of God.'
translations.web: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

translations.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
translations.ylt: And Jesus did rebuke him, saying, `Be silenced, and come forth out of him;' and the demon having cast him into the midst, came forth from him, having hurt him nought;
translations.web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

translations.kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
translations.ylt: and amazement came upon all, and they were speaking together, with one another, saying, `What is this word, that with authority and power he doth command the unclean spirits, and they come forth?'
translations.web: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

translations.kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
translations.ylt: and there was going forth a fame concerning him to every place of the region round about.
translations.web: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
