translations.kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
translations.ylt: And having risen out of the synagogue, he entered into the house of Simon, and the mother-in-law of Simon was pressed with a great fever, and they did ask him about her,
translations.web: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

translations.kjv: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
translations.ylt: and having stood over her, he rebuked the fever, and it left her, and presently, having risen, she was ministering to them.
translations.web: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

translations.kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
translations.ylt: And at the setting of the sun, all, as many as had any ailing with manifold sicknesses, brought them unto him, and he on each one of them his hands having put, did heal them.
translations.web: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

translations.kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
translations.ylt: And demons also were coming forth from many, crying out and saying--`Thou art the Christ, the Son of God;' and rebuking, he did not suffer them to speak, because they knew him to be the Christ.
translations.web: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

translations.kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
translations.ylt: And day having come, having gone forth, he went on to a desert place, and the multitudes were seeking him, and they came unto him, and were staying him--not to go on from them,
translations.web: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
translations.ylt: and he said unto them--`Also to the other cities it behoveth me to proclaim good news of the reign of God, because for this I have been sent;'
translations.web: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

translations.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
translations.ylt: and he was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
translations.web: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in the multitude pressing on him to hear the word of God, that he was standing beside the lake of Gennesaret,
translations.web: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

translations.kjv: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
translations.ylt: and he saw two boats standing beside the lake, and the fishers, having gone away from them, were washing the nets,
translations.web: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

translations.kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon’s, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
translations.ylt: and having entered into one of the boats, that was Simon's, he asked him to put back a little from the land, and having sat down, was teaching the multitudes out of the boat.
translations.web: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

translations.kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
translations.ylt: And when he left off speaking, he said unto Simon, `Put back to the deep, and let down your nets for a draught;'
translations.web: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

translations.kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
translations.ylt: and Simon answering said to him, `Master, through the whole night, having laboured, we have taken nothing, but at thy saying I will let down the net.'
translations.web: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

translations.kjv: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
translations.ylt: And having done this, they enclosed a great multitude of fishes, and their net was breaking,
translations.web: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

translations.kjv: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
translations.ylt: and they beckoned to the partners, who are in the other boat, having come, to help them; and they came, and filled both the boats, so that they were sinking.
translations.web: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

translations.kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
translations.ylt: And Simon Peter having seen, fell down at the knees of Jesus, saying, `Depart from me, because I am a sinful man, O lord;'
translations.web: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

translations.kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
translations.ylt: for astonishment seized him, and all those with him, at the draught of the fishes that they took,
translations.web: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

translations.kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
translations.ylt: and in like manner also James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon; and Jesus said unto Simon, `Fear not, henceforth thou shalt be catching men;'
translations.web: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

translations.kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
translations.ylt: and they, having brought the boats upon the land, having left all, did follow him.
translations.web: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in his being in one of the cities, that lo, a man full of leprosy, and having seen Jesus, having fallen on his face, he besought him, saying, `Sir, if thou mayest will, thou art able to cleanse me;'
translations.web: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

translations.kjv: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
translations.ylt: and having stretched forth his hand, he touched him, having said, `I will; be thou cleansed;' and immediately the leprosy went away from him.
translations.web: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

translations.kjv: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
translations.ylt: And he charged him to tell no one, `But, having gone away, shew thyself to the priest, and bring near for thy cleansing according as Moses directed, for a testimony to them;'
translations.web: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

translations.kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
translations.ylt: but the more was the report going abroad concerning him, and great multitudes were coming together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities,
translations.web: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

translations.kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
translations.ylt: and he was withdrawing himself in the desert places and was praying.
translations.web: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, on one of the days, that he was teaching, and there were sitting by Pharisees and teachers of the Law, who were come out of every village of Galilee, and Judea, and Jerusalem, and the power of the Lord was--to heal them.
translations.web: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

translations.kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
translations.ylt: And lo, men bearing upon a couch a man, who hath been struck with palsy, and they were seeking to bring him in, and to place before him,
translations.web: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

translations.kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
translations.ylt: and not having found by what way they may bring him in because of the multitude, having gone up on the house-top, through the tiles they let him down, with the little couch, into the midst before Jesus,
translations.web: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

translations.kjv: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
translations.ylt: and he having seen their faith, said to him, `Man, thy sins have been forgiven thee.'
translations.web: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

translations.kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
translations.ylt: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, `Who is this that doth speak evil words? who is able to forgive sins, except God only?'
translations.web: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

translations.kjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
translations.ylt: And Jesus having known their reasonings, answering, said unto them, `What reason ye in your hearts?
translations.web: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

translations.kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
translations.ylt: which is easier--to say, Thy sins have been forgiven thee? or to say, Arise, and walk?
translations.web: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

translations.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
translations.ylt: `And that ye may know that the Son of Man hath authority upon the earth to forgive sins--(he said to the one struck with palsy) --I say to thee, Arise, and having taken up thy little couch, be going on to thy house.'
translations.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

translations.kjv: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
translations.ylt: And presently having risen before them, having taken up that on which he was lying, he went away to his house, glorifying God,
translations.web: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

translations.kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
translations.ylt: and astonishment took all, and they were glorifying God, and were filled with fear, saying--`We saw strange things to-day.'
translations.web: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

translations.kjv: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
translations.ylt: And after these things he went forth, and beheld a tax-gatherer, by name Levi, sitting at the tax-office, and said to him, `Be following me;'
translations.web: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

translations.kjv: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
translations.ylt: and he, having left all, having arisen, did follow him.
translations.web: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

translations.kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
translations.ylt: And Levi made a great entertainment to him in his house, and there was a great multitude of tax-gatherers and others who were with them reclining (at meat),
translations.web: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

translations.kjv: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
translations.ylt: and the scribes and the Pharisees among them were murmuring at his disciples, saying, `Wherefore with tax-gatherers and sinners do ye eat and drink?'
translations.web: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said unto them, `They who are well have no need of a physician, but they that are ill:
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

translations.kjv: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
translations.ylt: I came not to call righteous men, but sinners, to reformation.'
translations.web: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

translations.kjv: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
translations.ylt: And they said unto him, `Wherefore do the disciples of John fast often, and make supplications--in like manner also those of the Pharisees--but thine do eat and drink?'
translations.web: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `Are ye able to make the sons of the bride-chamber--in the bridegroom being with them--to fast?
translations.web: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

translations.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
translations.ylt: but days will come, and, when the bridegroom may be taken away from them, then they shall fast in those days.'
translations.web: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

translations.kjv: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
translations.ylt: And he spake also a simile unto them--`No one a patch of new clothing doth put on old clothing, and if otherwise, the new also doth make a rent, and with the old the patch doth not agree, that is from the new.
translations.web: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

translations.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
translations.ylt: `And no one doth put new wine into old skins, and if otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins, and itself will be poured out, and the skins will be destroyed;
translations.web: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

translations.kjv: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
translations.ylt: but new wine into new skins is to be put, and both are preserved together;
translations.web: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

translations.kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
translations.ylt: and no one having drunk old wine, doth immediately wish new, for he saith, The old is better.'
translations.web: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, on the second-first sabbath, as he is going through the corn fields, that his disciples were plucking the ears, and were eating, rubbing with the hands,
translations.web: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

translations.kjv: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
translations.ylt: and certain of the Pharisees said to them, `Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbaths?'
translations.web: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said unto them, `Did ye not read even this that David did, when he hungered, himself and those who are with him,
translations.web: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

translations.kjv: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
translations.ylt: how he went into the house of God, and the loaves of the presentation did take, and did eat, and gave also to those with him, which it is not lawful to eat, except only to the priests?'
translations.web: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, --`The Son of Man is lord also of the sabbath.'
translations.web: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass also, on another sabbath, that he goeth into the synagogue, and teacheth, and there was there a man, and his right hand was withered,
translations.web: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

translations.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
translations.ylt: and the scribes and the Pharisees were watching him, if on the sabbath he will heal, that they might find an accusation against him.
translations.web: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

translations.kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
translations.ylt: And he himself had known their reasonings, and said to the man having the withered hand, `Rise, and stand in the midst;' and he having risen, stood.
translations.web: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
translations.ylt: Then said Jesus unto them, `I will question you something: Is it lawful on the sabbaths to do good, or to do evil? life to save or to kill?'
translations.web: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

translations.kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
translations.ylt: And having looked round on them all, he said to the man, `Stretch forth thy hand;' and he did so, and his hand was restored whole as the other;
translations.web: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

translations.kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
translations.ylt: and they were filled with madness, and were speaking with one another what they might do to Jesus.
translations.web: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass in those days, he went forth to the mountain to pray, and was passing the night in the prayer of God,
translations.web: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

translations.kjv: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
translations.ylt: and when it became day, he called near his disciples, and having chosen from them twelve, whom also he named apostles,
translations.web: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

translations.kjv: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
translations.ylt: (Simon, whom also he named Peter, and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
translations.web: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

translations.kjv: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alpheus, and Simon called Zelotes,
translations.ylt: Matthew and Thomas, James of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
translations.web: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

translations.kjv: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
translations.ylt: Judas of James, and Judas Iscariot, who also became betrayer;)
translations.web: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

translations.kjv: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
translations.ylt: and having come down with them, he stood upon a level spot, and a crowd of his disciples, and a great multitude of the people from all Judea, and Jerusalem, and the maritime Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him, and to be healed of their sicknesses,
translations.web: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

translations.kjv: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
translations.ylt: and those harassed by unclean spirits, and they were healed,
translations.web: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

translations.kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
translations.ylt: and all the multitude were seeking to touch him, because power from him was going forth, and he was healing all.
translations.web: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

translations.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: And he, having lifted up his eyes to his disciples, said: `Happy the poor--because yours is the reign of God.
translations.web: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

translations.kjv: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
translations.ylt: `Happy those hungering now--because ye shall be filled. `Happy those weeping now--because ye shall laugh.
translations.web: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

translations.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake.
translations.ylt: `Happy are ye when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you, and shall reproach, and shall cast forth your name as evil, for the Son of Man's sake--
translations.web: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

translations.kjv: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
translations.ylt: rejoice in that day, and leap, for lo, your reward is great in the heaven, for according to these things were their fathers doing to the prophets.
translations.web: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

translations.kjv: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
translations.ylt: `But woe to you--the rich, because ye have got your comfort.
translations.web: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you who have been filled--because ye shall hunger. `Woe to you who are laughing now--because ye shall mourn and weep.
translations.web: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you when all men shall speak well of you--for according to these things were their fathers doing to false prophets.
translations.web: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

translations.kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
translations.ylt: `But I say to you who are hearing, Love your enemies, do good to those hating you,
translations.web: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

translations.kjv: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
translations.ylt: bless those cursing you, and pray for those accusing you falsely;
translations.web: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

translations.kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
translations.ylt: and to him smiting thee upon the cheek, give also the other, and from him taking away from thee the mantle, also the coat thou mayest not keep back.
translations.web: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

translations.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
translations.ylt: `And to every one who is asking of thee, be giving; and from him who is taking away thy goods, be not asking again;
translations.web: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

translations.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
translations.ylt: and as ye wish that men may do to you, do ye also to them in like manner;
translations.web: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

translations.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
translations.ylt: and--if ye love those loving you, what grace have ye? for also the sinful love those loving them;
translations.web: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

translations.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
translations.ylt: and if ye do good to those doing good to you, what grace have ye? for also the sinful do the same;
translations.web: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

translations.kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
translations.ylt: and if ye lend to those of whom ye hope to receive back, what grace have ye? for also the sinful lend to sinners--that they may receive again as much.
translations.web: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

translations.kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
translations.ylt: `But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again, and your reward will be great, and ye shall be sons of the Highest, because He is kind unto the ungracious and evil;
translations.web: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

translations.kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
translations.ylt: be ye therefore merciful, as also your Father is merciful.
translations.web: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

translations.kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
translations.ylt: `And judge not, and ye may not be judged; condemn not, and ye may not be condemned; release, and ye shall be released.
translations.web: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

translations.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
translations.ylt: `Give, and it shall be given to you; good measure, pressed, and shaken, and running over, they shall give into your bosom; for with that measure with which ye measure, it shall be measured to you again.'
translations.web: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

translations.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
translations.ylt: And he spake a simile to them, `Is blind able to lead blind? shall they not both fall into a pit?
translations.web: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

translations.kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
translations.ylt: A disciple is not above his teacher, but every one perfected shall be as his teacher.
translations.web: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

translations.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
translations.ylt: `And why dost thou behold the mote that is in thy brother's eye, and the beam that is in thine own eye dost not consider?
translations.web: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

translations.kjv: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother’s eye.
translations.ylt: or how art thou able to say to thy brother, Brother, suffer, I may take out the mote that is in thine eye--thyself the beam in thine own eye not beholding? Hypocrite, take first the beam out of thine own eye, and then thou shalt see clearly to take out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
translations.web: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

translations.kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
translations.ylt: `For there is not a good tree making bad fruit, nor a bad tree making good fruit;
translations.web: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

translations.kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
translations.ylt: for each tree from its own fruit is known, for not from thorns do they gather figs, nor from a bramble do they crop a grape.
translations.web: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

translations.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
translations.ylt: `The good man out of the good treasure of his heart doth bring forth that which is good; and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart doth bring forth that which is evil; for out of the abounding of the heart doth his mouth speak.
translations.web: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

translations.kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
translations.ylt: `And why do ye call me, Lord, Lord, and do not what I say?
translations.web: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

translations.kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
translations.ylt: Every one who is coming unto me, and is hearing my words, and is doing them, I will shew you to whom he is like;
translations.web: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

translations.kjv: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
translations.ylt: he is like to a man building a house, who did dig, and deepen, and laid a foundation upon the rock, and a flood having come, the stream broke forth on that house, and was not able to shake it, for it had been founded upon the rock.
translations.web: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

translations.kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
translations.ylt: `And he who heard and did not, is like to a man having builded a house upon the earth, without a foundation, against which the stream brake forth, and immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house became great.'
translations.web: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

translations.kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
translations.ylt: And when he completed all his sayings in the ears of the people, he went into Capernaum;
translations.web: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

translations.kjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
translations.ylt: and a certain centurion's servant being ill, was about to die, who was much valued by him,
translations.web: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

translations.kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
translations.ylt: and having heard about Jesus, he sent unto him elders of the Jews, beseeching him, that having come he might thoroughly save his servant.
translations.web: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

translations.kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
translations.ylt: And they, having come near unto Jesus, were calling upon him earnestly, saying--`He is worthy to whom thou shalt do this,
translations.web: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

translations.kjv: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
translations.ylt: for he doth love our nation, and the synagogue he did build to us.'
translations.web: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
translations.ylt: And Jesus was going on with them, and now when he is not far distant from the house the centurion sent unto him friends, saying to him, `Sir, be not troubled, for I am not worthy that under my roof thou mayest enter;
translations.web: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

translations.kjv: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
translations.ylt: wherefore not even myself thought I worthy to come unto thee, but say in a word, and my lad shall be healed;
translations.web: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

translations.kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
translations.ylt: for I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers, and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Be coming, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doth it.'
translations.web: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

translations.kjv: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
translations.ylt: And having heard these things Jesus wondered at him, and having turned to the multitude following him, he said, `I say to you, not even in Israel so much faith did I find;'
translations.web: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

translations.kjv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
translations.ylt: and those sent, having turned back to the house, found the ailing servant in health.
translations.web: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, on the morrow, he was going on to a city called Nain, and there were going with him many of his disciples, and a great multitude,
translations.web: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

translations.kjv: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
translations.ylt: and as he came nigh to the gate of the city, then, lo, one dead was being carried forth, an only son of his mother, and she a widow, and a great multitude of the city was with her.
translations.web: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

translations.kjv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
translations.ylt: And the Lord having seen her, was moved with compassion towards her, and said to her, `Be not weeping;'
translations.web: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

translations.kjv: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
translations.ylt: and having come near, he touched the bier, and those bearing it stood still, and he said, `Young man, to thee I say, Arise;'
translations.web: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

translations.kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
translations.ylt: and the dead sat up, and began to speak, and he gave him to his mother;
translations.web: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

translations.kjv: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
translations.ylt: and fear took hold of all, and they were glorifying God, saying--`A great prophet hath risen among us,' and--`God did look upon His people.'
translations.web: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

translations.kjv: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judea, and throughout all the region round about.
translations.ylt: And the account of this went forth in all Judea about him, and in all the region around.
translations.web: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

translations.kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
translations.ylt: And the disciples of John told him about all these things,
translations.web: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

translations.kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
translations.ylt: and John having called near a certain two of his disciples, sent unto Jesus, saying, `Art thou he who is coming, or for another do we look?'
translations.web: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

translations.kjv: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
translations.ylt: And having come near to him, the men said, `John the Baptist sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he who is coming, or for another do we look?'
translations.web: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

translations.kjv: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
translations.ylt: And in that hour he cured many from sicknesses, and plagues, and evil spirits, and to many blind he granted sight.
translations.web: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

translations.kjv: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `Having gone on, report to John what ye saw and heard, that blind men do see again, lame do walk, lepers are cleansed, deaf do hear, dead are raised, poor have good news proclaimed;
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

translations.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
translations.ylt: and happy is he whoever may not be stumbled in me.'
translations.web: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

translations.kjv: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
translations.ylt: And the messengers of John having gone away, he began to say unto the multitudes concerning John: `What have ye gone forth to the wilderness to look on? a reed by the wind shaken?
translations.web: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

translations.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
translations.ylt: but what have ye gone forth to see? a man in soft garments clothed? lo, they in splendid apparellings, and living in luxury, are in the houses of kings!
translations.web: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

translations.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
translations.ylt: `But what have ye gone forth to see? a prophet? Yes, I say to you, and much more than a prophet:
translations.web: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

translations.kjv: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
translations.ylt: this is he concerning whom it hath been written, Lo, I send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee;
translations.web: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

translations.kjv: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
translations.ylt: for I say to you, a greater prophet, among those born of women, than John the Baptist there is not; but the least in the reign of God is greater than he.'
translations.web: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

translations.kjv: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
translations.ylt: And all the people having heard, and the tax-gatherers, declared God righteous, having been baptized with the baptism of John,
translations.web: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

translations.kjv: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
translations.ylt: but the Pharisees, and the lawyers, the counsel of God did put away for themselves, not having been baptized by him.
translations.web: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

translations.kjv: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
translations.ylt: And the Lord said, `To what, then, shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
translations.web: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

translations.kjv: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
translations.ylt: they are like to children, to those sitting in a market-place, and calling one to another, and saying, We piped to you, and ye did not dance, we mourned to you, and ye did not weep!
translations.web: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

translations.kjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
translations.ylt: `For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and ye say, He hath a demon;
translations.web: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

translations.kjv: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
translations.ylt: the Son of Man came eating and drinking, and ye say, Lo, a man, a glutton, and a wine drinker, a friend of tax-gatherers and sinners;
translations.web: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

translations.kjv: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
translations.ylt: and the wisdom was justified from all her children.'
translations.web: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

translations.kjv: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
translations.ylt: And a certain one of the Pharisees was asking him that he might eat with him, and having gone into the house of the Pharisee he reclined (at meat),
translations.web: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

translations.kjv: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
translations.ylt: and lo, a woman in the city, who was a sinner, having known that he reclineth (at meat) in the house of the Pharisee, having provided an alabaster box of ointment,
translations.web: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

translations.kjv: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
translations.ylt: and having stood behind, beside his feet, weeping, she began to wet his feet with the tears, and with the hairs of her head she was wiping, and was kissing his feet, and was anointing with the ointment.
translations.web: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

translations.kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
translations.ylt: And the Pharisee who did call him, having seen, spake within himself, saying, `This one, if he were a prophet, would have known who and of what kind is the woman who doth touch him, that she is a sinner.'
translations.web: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said unto him, `Simon, I have something to say to thee;' and he saith, `Teacher, say on.'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

translations.kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
translations.ylt: `Two debtors were to a certain creditor; the one was owing five hundred denaries, and the other fifty;
translations.web: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

translations.kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
translations.ylt: and they not having wherewith to give back, he forgave both; which then of them, say thou, will love him more?'
translations.web: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

translations.kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
translations.ylt: And Simon answering said, `I suppose that to whom he forgave the more;' and he said to him, `Rightly thou didst judge.'
translations.web: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

translations.kjv: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
translations.ylt: And having turned unto the woman, he said to Simon, `Seest thou this woman? I entered into thy house; water for my feet thou didst not give, but this woman with tears did wet my feet, and with the hairs of her head did wipe;
translations.web: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

translations.kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
translations.ylt: a kiss to me thou didst not give, but this woman, from what time I came in, did not cease kissing my feet;
translations.web: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

translations.kjv: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
translations.ylt: with oil my head thou didst not anoint, but this woman with ointment did anoint my feet;
translations.web: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

translations.kjv: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
translations.ylt: therefore I say to thee, her many sins have been forgiven, because she did love much; but to whom little is forgiven, little he doth love.'
translations.web: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
translations.ylt: And he said to her, `Thy sins have been forgiven;'
translations.web: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

translations.kjv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
translations.ylt: and those reclining with him (at meat) began to say within themselves, `Who is this, who also doth forgive sins?'
translations.web: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

translations.kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
translations.ylt: and he said unto the woman, `Thy faith have saved thee, be going on to peace.'
translations.web: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass thereafter, that he was going through every city and village, preaching and proclaiming good news of the reign of God, and the twelve are with him,
translations.web: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

translations.kjv: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
translations.ylt: and certain women, who were healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary who is called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone forth,
translations.web: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

translations.kjv: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
translations.ylt: and Joanna wife of Chuza, steward of Herod, and Susanna, and many others, who were ministering to him from their substance.
translations.web: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

translations.kjv: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
translations.ylt: And a great multitude having gathered, and those who from city and city were coming unto him, he spake by a simile:
translations.web: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:

translations.kjv: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
translations.ylt: `The sower went forth to sow his seed, and in his sowing some indeed fell beside the way, and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the heaven did devour it.
translations.web: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

translations.kjv: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
translations.ylt: `And other fell upon the rock, and having sprung up, it did wither, through not having moisture.
translations.web: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

translations.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
translations.ylt: `And other fell amidst the thorns, and the thorns having sprung up with it, did choke it.
translations.web: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

translations.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
translations.ylt: `And other fell upon the good ground, and having sprung up, it made fruit an hundred fold.' These things saying, he was calling, `He having ears to hear--let him hear.'
translations.web: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

translations.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
translations.ylt: And his disciples were questioning him, saying, `What may this simile be?'
translations.web: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

translations.kjv: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
translations.ylt: And he said, `To you it hath been given to know the secrets of the reign of God, and to the rest in similes; that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.
translations.web: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

translations.kjv: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
translations.ylt: `And this is the simile: The seed is the word of God,
translations.web: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

translations.kjv: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
translations.ylt: and those beside the way are those hearing, then cometh the Devil, and taketh up the word from their heart, lest having believed, they may be saved.
translations.web: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

translations.kjv: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
translations.ylt: `And those upon the rock: They who, when they may hear, with joy do receive the word, and these have no root, who for a time believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
translations.web: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

translations.kjv: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
translations.ylt: `And that which fell to the thorns: These are they who have heard, and going forth, through anxieties, and riches, and pleasures of life, are choked, and bear not to completion.
translations.web: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

translations.kjv: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
translations.ylt: `And that in the good ground: These are they, who in an upright and good heart, having heard the word, do retain it, and bear fruit in continuance.
translations.web: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

translations.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
translations.ylt: `And no one having lighted a lamp doth cover it with a vessel, or under a couch doth put it; but upon a lamp-stand he doth put it, that those coming in may see the light,
translations.web: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

translations.kjv: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
translations.ylt: for nothing is secret, that shall not become manifest, nor hid, that shall not be known, and become manifest.
translations.web: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

translations.kjv: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
translations.ylt: `See, therefore, how ye hear, for whoever may have, there shall be given to him, and whoever may not have, also what he seemeth to have, shall be taken from him.'
translations.web: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

translations.kjv: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
translations.ylt: And there came unto him his mother and brethren, and they were not able to get to him because of the multitude,
translations.web: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

translations.kjv: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
translations.ylt: and it was told him, saying, `Thy mother and thy brethren do stand without, wishing to see thee;'
translations.web: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
translations.ylt: and he answering said unto them, `My mother and my brethren! they are those who the word of God are hearing, and doing.'
translations.web: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

translations.kjv: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, on one of the days, that he himself went into a boat with his disciples, and he said unto them, `We may go over to the other side of the lake;' and they set forth,
translations.web: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

translations.kjv: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
translations.ylt: and as they are sailing he fell deeply asleep, and there came down a storm of wind to the lake, and they were filling, and were in peril.
translations.web: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

translations.kjv: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
translations.ylt: And having come near, they awoke him, saying, `Master, master, we perish;' and he, having arisen, rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and there came a calm,
translations.web: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `Where is your faith?' and they being afraid did wonder, saying unto one another, `Who, then, is this, that even the winds he doth command, and the water, and they obey him?'
translations.web: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

translations.kjv: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
translations.ylt: And they sailed down to the region of the Gadarenes, that is over-against Galilee,
translations.web: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

translations.kjv: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
translations.ylt: and he having gone forth upon the land, there met him a certain man, out of the city, who had demons for a long time, and with a garment was not clothed, and in a house was not abiding, but in the tombs,
translations.web: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

translations.kjv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
translations.ylt: and having seen Jesus, and having cried out, he fell before him, and with a loud voice, said, `What--to me and to thee, Jesus, Son of God Most High? I beseech thee, mayest thou not afflict me!'
translations.web: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

translations.kjv: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
translations.ylt: For he commanded the unclean spirit to come forth from the man, for many times it had caught him, and he was being bound with chains and fetters--guarded, and breaking asunder the bonds he was driven by the demons to the deserts.
translations.web: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

translations.kjv: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
translations.ylt: And Jesus questioned him, saying, `What is thy name?' and he said, `Legion,' (because many demons were entered into him,)
translations.web: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

translations.kjv: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
translations.ylt: and he was calling on him, that he may not command them to go away to the abyss,
translations.web: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

translations.kjv: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
translations.ylt: and there was there a herd of many swine feeding in the mountain, and they were calling on him, that he might suffer them to enter into these, and he suffered them,
translations.web: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

translations.kjv: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
translations.ylt: and the demons having gone forth from the man, did enter into the swine, and the herd rushed down the steep to the lake, and were choked.
translations.web: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

translations.kjv: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
translations.ylt: And those feeding them, having seen what was come to pass, fled, and having gone, told it to the city, and to the fields;
translations.web: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

translations.kjv: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
translations.ylt: and they came forth to see what was come to pass, and they came unto Jesus, and found the man sitting, out of whom the demons had gone forth, clothed, and right-minded, at the feet of Jesus, and they were afraid;
translations.web: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

translations.kjv: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
translations.ylt: and those also having seen it, told them how the demoniac was saved.
translations.web: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

translations.kjv: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
translations.ylt: And the whole multitude of the region of the Gadarenes round about asked him to go away from them, because with great fear they were pressed, and he having entered into the boat, did turn back.
