translations.web: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

translations.kjv: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
translations.ylt: And the man from whom the demons had gone forth was beseeching of him to be with him, and Jesus sent him away, saying,
translations.web: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

translations.kjv: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
translations.ylt: `Turn back to thy house, and tell how great things God did to thee;' and he went away through all the city proclaiming how great things Jesus did to him.
translations.web: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in the turning back of Jesus, the multitude received him, for they were all looking for him,
translations.web: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus’ feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
translations.ylt: and lo, there came a man, whose name is Jairus, and he was a chief of the synagogue, and having fallen at the feet of Jesus, was calling on him to come to his house;
translations.web: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

translations.kjv: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
translations.ylt: because he had an only daughter about twelve years old, and she was dying. And in his going away, the multitudes were thronging him,
translations.web: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

translations.kjv: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
translations.ylt: and a woman, having an issue of blood for twelve years, who, having spent on physicians all her living, was not able to be healed by any,
translations.web: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

translations.kjv: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
translations.ylt: having come near behind, touched the fringe of his garment, and presently the issue of her blood stood.
translations.web: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

translations.kjv: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
translations.ylt: And Jesus said, `Who is it that touched me?' and all denying, Peter and those with him said, `Master, the multitudes press thee, and throng thee, and thou dost say, Who is it that touched me!'
translations.web: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said, `Some one did touch me, for I knew power having gone forth from me.'
translations.web: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

translations.kjv: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
translations.ylt: And the woman, having seen that she was not hid, trembling, came, and having fallen before him, for what cause she touched him declared to him before all the people, and how she was healed presently;
translations.web: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

translations.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
translations.ylt: and he said to her, `Take courage, daughter, thy faith hath saved thee, be going on to peace.'
translations.web: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

translations.kjv: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
translations.ylt: While he is yet speaking, there doth come a certain one from the chief of the synagogue's house, saying to him--`Thy daughter hath died, harass not the Teacher;'
translations.web: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

translations.kjv: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having heard, answered him, saying, `Be not afraid, only believe, and she shall be saved.'
translations.web: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

translations.kjv: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
translations.ylt: And having come to the house, he suffered no one to go in, except Peter, and James, and John, and the father of the child, and the mother;
translations.web: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

translations.kjv: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
translations.ylt: and they were all weeping, and beating themselves for her, and he said, `Weep not, she did not die, but doth sleep;
translations.web: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

translations.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
translations.ylt: and they were deriding him, knowing that she did die;
translations.web: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

translations.kjv: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
translations.ylt: and he having put all forth without, and having taken hold of her hand, called, saying, `Child, arise;'
translations.web: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

translations.kjv: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
translations.ylt: and her spirit came back, and she arose presently, and he directed that there be given to her to eat;
translations.web: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

translations.kjv: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
translations.ylt: and her parents were amazed, but he charged them to say to no one what was come to pass.
translations.web: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

translations.kjv: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
translations.ylt: And having called together his twelve disciples, he gave them power and authority over all the demons, and to cure sicknesses,
translations.web: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

translations.kjv: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
translations.ylt: and he sent them to proclaim the reign of God, and to heal the ailing.
translations.web: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `Take nothing for the way, neither staff, nor scrip, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats each;
translations.web: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

translations.kjv: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
translations.ylt: and into whatever house ye may enter, there remain, and thence depart;
translations.web: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

translations.kjv: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
translations.ylt: and as many as may not receive you, going forth from that city, even the dust from your feet shake off, for a testimony against them.'
translations.web: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

translations.kjv: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
translations.ylt: And going forth they were going through the several villages, proclaiming good news, and healing everywhere.
translations.web: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

translations.kjv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
translations.ylt: And Herod the tetrarch heard of all the things being done by him, and was perplexed, because it was said by certain, that John hath been raised out of the dead;
translations.web: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

translations.kjv: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
translations.ylt: and by certain, that Elijah did appear, and by others, that a prophet, one of the ancients, was risen;
translations.web: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

translations.kjv: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
translations.ylt: and Herod said, `John I did behead, but who is this concerning whom I hear such things?' and he was seeking to see him.
translations.web: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

translations.kjv: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
translations.ylt: And the apostles having turned back, declared to him how great things they did, and having taken them, he withdrew by himself to a desert place of a city called Bethsaida,
translations.web: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

translations.kjv: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
translations.ylt: and the multitudes having known did follow him, and having received them, he was speaking to them concerning the reign of God, and those having need of service he cured.
translations.web: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

translations.kjv: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
translations.ylt: And the day began to decline, and the twelve having come near, said to him, `Let away the multitude, that having gone to the villages and the fields round about, they may lodge and may find provision, because here we are in a desert place.'
translations.web: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

translations.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `Give ye them to eat;' and they said, `We have no more than five loaves, and two fishes: except, having gone, we may buy for all this people victuals;'
translations.web: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

translations.kjv: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
translations.ylt: for they were about five thousand men. And he said unto his disciples, `Cause them to recline in companies, in each fifty;'
translations.web: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

translations.kjv: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
translations.ylt: and they did so, and made all to recline;
translations.web: They did so, and made them all sit down.

translations.kjv: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
translations.ylt: and having taken the five loaves, and the two fishes, having looked up to the heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and was giving to the disciples to set before the multitude;
translations.web: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

translations.kjv: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
translations.ylt: and they did eat, and were all filled, and there was taken up what was over to them of broken pieces, twelve baskets.
translations.web: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, as he is praying alone, the disciples were with him, and he questioned them, saying, `Who do the multitudes say me to be?'
translations.web: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

translations.kjv: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
translations.ylt: And they answering said, `John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; and others, that a prophet, one of the ancients, was risen;'
translations.web: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

translations.kjv: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `And ye--who do ye say me to be?' and Peter answering said, `The Christ of God.'
translations.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

translations.kjv: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
translations.ylt: And having charged them, he commanded them to say this to no one,
translations.web: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

translations.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
translations.ylt: saying--`It behoveth the Son of Man to suffer many things, and to be rejected by the elders, and chief priests, and scribes, and to be killed, and the third day to be raised.'
translations.web: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

translations.kjv: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
translations.ylt: And he said unto all, `If any one doth will to come after me, let him disown himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me;
translations.web: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

translations.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
translations.ylt: for whoever may will to save his life, shall lose it, and whoever may lose his life for my sake, he shall save it;
translations.web: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

translations.kjv: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
translations.ylt: for what is a man profited, having gained the whole world, and having lost or having forfeited himself?
translations.web: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

translations.kjv: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father’s, and of the holy angels.
translations.ylt: `For whoever may be ashamed of me, and of my words, of this one shall the Son of Man be ashamed, when he may come in his glory, and the Father's, and the holy messengers';
translations.web: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

translations.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: and I say to you, truly, there are certain of those here standing, who shall not taste of death till they may see the reign of God.'
translations.web: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, after these words, as it were eight days, that having taken Peter, and John, and James, he went up to the mountain to pray,
translations.web: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

translations.kjv: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
translations.ylt: and it came to pass, in his praying, the appearance of his face became altered, and his garment white--sparkling.
translations.web: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
translations.ylt: And lo, two men were speaking together with him, who were Moses and Elijah,
translations.web: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

translations.kjv: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: who having appeared in glory, spake of his outgoing that he was about to fulfil in Jerusalem,
translations.web: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
translations.ylt: but Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep, and having waked, they saw his glory, and the two men standing with him.
translations.web: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in their parting from him, Peter said unto Jesus, `Master, it is good to us to be here; and we may make three booths, one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah,' not knowing what he saith:
translations.web: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

translations.kjv: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
translations.ylt: and as he was speaking these things, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them, and they feared in their entering into the cloud,
translations.web: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

translations.kjv: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
translations.ylt: and a voice came out of the cloud saying, `This is My Son--the Beloved; hear ye him;'
translations.web: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

translations.kjv: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
translations.ylt: and when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone; and they were silent, and declared to no one in those days anything of what they have seen.
translations.web: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass on the next day, they having come down from the mount, there met him a great multitude,
translations.web: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

translations.kjv: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
translations.ylt: and lo, a man from the multitude cried out, saying, `Teacher, I beseech thee, look upon my son, because he is my only begotten;
translations.web: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

translations.kjv: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
translations.ylt: and lo, a spirit doth take him, and suddenly he doth cry out, and it teareth him, with foaming, and it hardly departeth from him, bruising him,
translations.web: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

translations.kjv: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
translations.ylt: and I besought thy disciples that they might cast it out, and they were not able.'
translations.web: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said, `O generation, unstedfast and perverse, till when shall I be with you, and suffer you? bring near hither thy son;'
translations.web: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

translations.kjv: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
translations.ylt: and as he is yet coming near, the demon rent him, and tore him sore, and Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the youth, and gave him back to his father.
translations.web: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

translations.kjv: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
translations.ylt: And they were all amazed at the greatness of God, and while all are wondering at all things that Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
translations.web: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

translations.kjv: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
translations.ylt: `Lay ye to your ears these words, for the Son of Man is about to be delivered up to the hands of men.'
translations.web: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

translations.kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
translations.ylt: And they were not knowing this saying, and it was veiled from them, that they might not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
translations.web: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

translations.kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
translations.ylt: And there entered a reasoning among them, this, Who may be greater of them?
translations.web: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

translations.kjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
translations.ylt: and Jesus having seen the reasoning of their heart, having taken hold of a child, set him beside himself,
translations.web: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

translations.kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
translations.ylt: and said to them, `Whoever may receive this child in my name, doth receive me, and whoever may receive me, doth receive Him who sent me, for he who is least among you all--he shall be great.'
translations.web: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

translations.kjv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
translations.ylt: And John answering said, `Master, we saw a certain one in thy name casting forth the demons, and we forbade him, because he doth not follow with us;'
translations.web: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said unto him, `Forbid not, for he who is not against us, is for us.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in the completing of the days of his being taken up, that he fixed his face to go on to Jerusalem,
translations.web: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

translations.kjv: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
translations.ylt: and he sent messengers before his face, and having gone on, they went into a village of Samaritans, to make ready for him,
translations.web: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

translations.kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: and they did not receive him, because his face was going on to Jerusalem.
translations.web: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
translations.ylt: And his disciples James and John having seen, said, `Sir, wilt thou that we may command fire to come down from the heaven, and to consume them, as also Elijah did?'
translations.web: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

translations.kjv: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
translations.ylt: and having turned, he rebuked them, and said, `Ye have not known of what spirit ye are;
translations.web: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

translations.kjv: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
translations.ylt: for the Son of Man did not come to destroy men's lives, but to save;' and they went on to another village.
translations.web: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, as they are going on in the way, a certain one said unto him, `I will follow thee wherever thou mayest go, sir;'
translations.web: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to him, `The foxes have holes, and the fowls of the heaven places of rest, but the Son of Man hath not where he may recline the head.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
translations.ylt: And he said unto another, `Be following me;' and he said, `Sir, permit me, having gone away, first to bury my father;'
translations.web: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

translations.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to him, `Suffer the dead to bury their own dead, and thou, having gone away, publish the reign of God.'
translations.web: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
translations.ylt: And another also said, `I will follow thee, sir, but first permit me to take leave of those in my house;'
translations.web: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said unto him, `No one having put his hand on a plough, and looking back, is fit for the reign of God.'
translations.web: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
translations.ylt: And after these things, the Lord did appoint also other seventy, and sent them by twos before his face, to every city and place whither he himself was about to come,
translations.web: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

translations.kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
translations.ylt: then said he unto them, `The harvest indeed is abundant, but the workmen few; beseech ye then the Lord of the harvest, that He may put forth workmen to His harvest.
translations.web: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

translations.kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
translations.ylt: `Go away; lo, I send you forth as lambs in the midst of wolves;
translations.web: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

translations.kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
translations.ylt: carry no bag, no scrip, nor sandals; and salute no one on the way;
translations.web: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

translations.kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
translations.ylt: and into whatever house ye do enter, first say, Peace to this house;
translations.web: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

translations.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
translations.ylt: and if indeed there may be there the son of peace, rest on it shall your peace; and if not so, upon you it shall turn back.
translations.web: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

translations.kjv: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
translations.ylt: `And in that house remain, eating and drinking the things they have, for worthy is the workman of his hire; go not from house to house,
translations.web: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

translations.kjv: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
translations.ylt: and into whatever city ye enter, and they may receive you, eat the things set before you,
translations.web: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

translations.kjv: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
translations.ylt: and heal the ailing in it, and say to them, The reign of God hath come nigh to you.
translations.web: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

translations.kjv: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
translations.ylt: `And into whatever city ye do enter, and they may not receive you, having gone forth to its broad places, say,
translations.web: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

translations.kjv: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
translations.ylt: And the dust that hath cleaved to us, from your city, we do wipe off against you, but this know ye, that the reign of God hath come nigh to you;
translations.web: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
translations.ylt: and I say to you, that for Sodom in that day it shall be more tolerable than for that city.
translations.web: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

translations.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
translations.ylt: `Woe to thee, Chorazin; woe to thee, Bethsaida; for if in Tyre and Sidon had been done the mighty works that were done in you, long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes, they had reformed;
translations.web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

translations.kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
translations.ylt: but for Tyre and Sidon it shall be more tolerable in the judgment than for you.
translations.web: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

translations.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
translations.ylt: `And thou, Capernaum, which unto the heaven wast exalted, unto hades thou shalt be brought down.
translations.web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

translations.kjv: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
translations.ylt: `He who is hearing you, doth hear me; and he who is putting you away, doth put me away; and he who is putting me away, doth put away Him who sent me.'
translations.web: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

translations.kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
translations.ylt: And the seventy turned back with joy, saying, `Sir, and the demons are being subjected to us in thy name;'
translations.web: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `I was beholding the Adversary, as lightning from the heaven having fallen;
translations.web: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

translations.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
translations.ylt: lo, I give to you the authority to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and on all the power of the enemy, and nothing by any means shall hurt you;
translations.web: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

translations.kjv: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
translations.ylt: but, in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subjected to you, but rejoice rather that your names were written in the heavens.'
translations.web: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

translations.kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
translations.ylt: In that hour was Jesus glad in the Spirit, and said, `I do confess to thee, Father, Lord of the heaven and of the earth, that Thou didst hide these things from wise men and understanding, and didst reveal them to babes; yes, Father, because so it became good pleasure before Thee.
translations.web: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

translations.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
translations.ylt: `All things were delivered up to me by my Father, and no one doth know who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whom the Son may wish to reveal Him.'
translations.web: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

translations.kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
translations.ylt: And having turned unto the disciples, he said, by themselves, `Happy the eyes that are perceiving what ye perceive;
translations.web: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

translations.kjv: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
translations.ylt: for I say to you, that many prophets and kings did wish to see what ye perceive, and did not see, and to hear what ye hear, and did not hear.'
translations.web: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

translations.kjv: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
translations.ylt: And lo, a certain lawyer stood up, trying him, and saying, `Teacher, what having done, life age-during shall I inherit?'
translations.web: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

translations.kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
translations.ylt: And he said unto him, `In the law what hath been written? how dost thou read?'
translations.web: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

translations.kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
translations.ylt: And he answering said, `Thou shalt love the Lord thy God out of all thy heart, and out of all thy soul, and out of all thy strength, and out of all thy understanding, and thy neighbour as thyself.'
translations.web: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
translations.ylt: And he said to him, `Rightly thou didst answer; this do, and thou shalt live.'
translations.web: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

translations.kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
translations.ylt: And he, willing to declare himself righteous, said unto Jesus, `And who is my neighbour?'
translations.web: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having taken up the word, said, `A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among robbers, and having stripped him and inflicted blows, they went away, leaving him half dead.
translations.web: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

translations.kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
translations.ylt: `And by a coincidence a certain priest was going down in that way, and having seen him, he passed over on the opposite side;
translations.web: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

translations.kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
translations.ylt: and in like manner also, a Levite, having been about the place, having come and seen, passed over on the opposite side.
translations.web: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

translations.kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
translations.ylt: `But a certain Samaritan, journeying, came along him, and having seen him, he was moved with compassion,
translations.web: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

translations.kjv: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
translations.ylt: and having come near, he bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine, and having lifted him up on his own beast, he brought him to an inn, and was careful of him;
translations.web: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

translations.kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
translations.ylt: and on the morrow, going forth, taking out two denaries, he gave to the innkeeper, and said to him, Be careful of him, and whatever thou mayest spend more, I, in my coming again, will give back to thee.
translations.web: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

translations.kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
translations.ylt: `Who, then, of these three, seemeth to thee to have become neighbour of him who fell among the robbers?'
translations.web: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

translations.kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
translations.ylt: and he said, `He who did the kindness with him,' then Jesus said to him, `Be going on, and thou be doing in like manner.'
translations.web: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

translations.kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in their going on, that he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman, by name Martha, did receive him into her house,
translations.web: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

translations.kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
translations.ylt: and she had also a sister, called Mary, who also, having seated herself beside the feet of Jesus, was hearing the word,
translations.web: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

translations.kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
translations.ylt: and Martha was distracted about much serving, and having stood by him, she said, `Sir, dost thou not care that my sister left me alone to serve? say then to her, that she may partake along with me.'
translations.web: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to her, `Martha, Martha, thou art anxious and disquieted about many things,
translations.web: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

translations.kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
translations.ylt: but of one thing there is need, and Mary the good part did choose, that shall not be taken away from her.'
translations.web: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in his being in a certain place praying, as he ceased, a certain one of his disciples said unto him, `Sir, teach us to pray, as also John taught his disciples.'
translations.web: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `When ye may pray, say ye: Our Father who art in the heavens; hallowed be Thy name: Thy reign come; Thy will come to pass, as in heaven also on earth;
translations.web: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

translations.kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.
translations.ylt: our appointed bread be giving us daily;
translations.web: Give us day by day our daily bread.

translations.kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
translations.ylt: and forgive us our sins, for also we ourselves forgive every one indebted to us; and mayest Thou not bring us into temptation; but do Thou deliver us from the evil.'
translations.web: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `Who of you shall have a friend, and shall go on unto him at midnight, and may say to him, Friend, lend me three loaves,
translations.web: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

translations.kjv: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
translations.ylt: seeing a friend of mine came out of the way unto me, and I have not what I shall set before him,
translations.web: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

translations.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
translations.ylt: and he from within answering may say, Do not give me trouble, already the door hath been shut, and my children with me are in the bed, I am not able, having risen, to give to thee.
translations.web: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

translations.kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
translations.ylt: `I say to you, even if he will not give to him, having risen, because of his being his friend, yet because of his importunity, having risen, he will give him as many as he doth need;
translations.web: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

translations.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
translations.ylt: and I say to you, Ask, and it shall be given to you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened to you;
translations.web: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

translations.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
translations.ylt: for every one who is asking doth receive; and he who is seeking doth find; and to him who is knocking it shall be opened.
translations.web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

translations.kjv: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
translations.ylt: `And of which of you--the father--if the son shall ask a loaf, a stone will he present to him? and if a fish, will he instead of a fish, a serpent present to him?
translations.web: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

translations.kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
translations.ylt: and if he may ask an egg, will he present to him a scorpion?
translations.web: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

translations.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
translations.ylt: If, then, ye, being evil, have known good gifts to be giving to your children, how much more shall the Father who is from heaven give the Holy Spirit to those asking Him!'
translations.web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

translations.kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
translations.ylt: And he was casting forth a demon, and it was dumb, and it came to pass, the demon having gone forth, the dumb man spake, and the multitudes wondered,
translations.web: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

translations.kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
translations.ylt: and certain of them said, `By Beelzeboul, ruler of the demons, he doth cast forth the demons;'
translations.web: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

translations.kjv: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
translations.ylt: and others, tempting, a sign out of heaven from him were asking.
translations.web: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

translations.kjv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
translations.ylt: And he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, `Every kingdom having been divided against itself is desolated; and house against house doth fall;
translations.web: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

translations.kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
translations.ylt: and if also the Adversary against himself was divided, how shall his kingdom be made to stand? for ye say, by Beelzeboul is my casting forth the demons.
translations.web: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

translations.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
translations.ylt: `But if I by Beelzeboul cast forth the demons--your sons, by whom do they cast forth? because of this your judges they shall be;
translations.web: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

translations.kjv: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
translations.ylt: but if by the finger of God I cast forth the demons, then come unawares upon you did the reign of God.
translations.web: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

translations.kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
translations.ylt: `When the strong man armed may keep his hall, in peace are his goods;
translations.web: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

translations.kjv: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
translations.ylt: but when the stronger than he, having come upon him, may overcome him, his whole-armour he doth take away in which he had trusted, and his spoils he distributeth;
translations.web: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

translations.kjv: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
translations.ylt: he who is not with me is against me, and he who is not gathering with me doth scatter.
translations.web: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

translations.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
translations.ylt: `When the unclean spirit may go forth from the man it walketh through waterless places seeking rest, and not finding, it saith, I will turn back to my house whence I came forth;
translations.web: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

translations.kjv: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
translations.ylt: and having come, it findeth it swept and adorned;
translations.web: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

translations.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
translations.ylt: then doth it go, and take to it seven other spirits more evil than itself, and having entered, they dwell there, and the last of that man becometh worst than the first.'
translations.web: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in his saying these things, a certain woman having lifted up the voice out of the multitude, said to him, `Happy the womb that carried thee, and the paps that thou didst suck!'
translations.web: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

translations.kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
translations.ylt: And he said, `Yea, rather, happy those hearing the word of God, and keeping it!'
translations.web: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

translations.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
translations.ylt: And the multitudes crowding together upon him, he began to say, `This generation is evil, a sign it doth seek after, and a sign shall not be given to it, except the sign of Jonah the prophet,
translations.web: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

translations.kjv: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
translations.ylt: for as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so also shall the Son of Man be to this generation.
translations.web: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

translations.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
translations.ylt: `A queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and shall condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and lo, greater than Solomon here!
translations.web: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

translations.kjv: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
translations.ylt: `Men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it, because they reformed at the proclamation of Jonah; and lo, greater than Jonah here!
translations.web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

translations.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
translations.ylt: `And no one having lighted a lamp, doth put it in a secret place, nor under the measure, but on the lamp-stand, that those coming in may behold the light.
translations.web: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

translations.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
translations.ylt: `The lamp of the body is the eye, when then thine eye may be simple, thy whole body also is lightened; and when it may be evil, thy body also is darkened;
translations.web: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

translations.kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
translations.ylt: take heed, then, lest the light that is in thee be darkness;
translations.web: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

translations.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
translations.ylt: if then thy whole body is lightened, not having any part darkened, the whole shall be lightened, as when the lamp by the brightness may give thee light.'
translations.web: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

translations.kjv: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
translations.ylt: And in his speaking, a certain Pharisee was asking him that he might dine with him, and having gone in, he reclined (at meat),
translations.web: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

translations.kjv: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
translations.ylt: and the Pharisee having seen, did wonder that he did not first baptize himself before the dinner.
translations.web: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

translations.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
translations.ylt: And the Lord said unto him, `Now do ye, the Pharisees, the outside of the cup and of the plate make clean, but your inward part is full of rapine and wickedness;
translations.web: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

translations.kjv: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
translations.ylt: unthinking! did not He who made the outside also the inside make?
translations.web: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

translations.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
translations.ylt: But what ye have give ye as alms, and, lo, all things are clean to you.
translations.web: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

translations.kjv: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
translations.ylt: `But woe to you, the Pharisees, because ye tithe the mint, and the rue, and every herb, and ye pass by the judgment, and the love of God; these things it behoveth to do, and those not to be neglecting.
translations.web: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you, the Pharisees, because ye love the first seats in the synagogues, and the salutations in the market-places.
translations.web: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because ye are as the unseen tombs, and the men walking above have not known.'
translations.web: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

translations.kjv: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
translations.ylt: And one of the lawyers answering, saith to him, `Teacher, these things saying, us also thou dost insult;'
translations.web: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

translations.kjv: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
translations.ylt: and he said, `And to you, the lawyers, woe! because ye burden men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves with one of your fingers do not touch the burdens.
translations.web: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you, because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
translations.web: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

translations.kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
translations.ylt: Then do ye testify, and are well pleased with the works of your fathers, because they indeed killed them, and ye do build their tombs;
translations.web: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

translations.kjv: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
translations.ylt: because of this also the wisdom of God said: I will send to them prophets, and apostles, and some of them they shall kill and persecute,
translations.web: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

translations.kjv: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
translations.ylt: that the blood of all the prophets, that is being poured forth from the foundation of the world, may be required from this generation;
translations.web: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

translations.kjv: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
translations.ylt: from the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, who perished between the altar and the house; yes, I say to you, It shall be required from this generation.
translations.web: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

translations.kjv: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
translations.ylt: `Woe to you, the lawyers, because ye took away the key of the knowledge; yourselves ye did not enter; and those coming in, ye did hinder.'
translations.web: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

translations.kjv: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
translations.ylt: And in his speaking these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began fearfully to urge and to press him to speak about many things,
translations.web: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

translations.kjv: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
translations.ylt: laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
translations.web: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

translations.kjv: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
translations.ylt: At which time the myriads of the multitude having been gathered together, so as to tread upon one another, he began to say unto his disciples, first, `Take heed to yourselves of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy;
translations.web: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

translations.kjv: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
translations.ylt: and there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known;
translations.web: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

translations.kjv: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
translations.ylt: because whatever in the darkness ye said, in the light shall be heard: and what to the ear ye spake in the inner-chambers, shall be proclaimed upon the house-tops.
translations.web: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

translations.kjv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
translations.ylt: `And I say to you, my friends, be not afraid of those killing the body, and after these things are not having anything over to do;
translations.web: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

translations.kjv: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
translations.ylt: but I will show to you, whom ye may fear; Fear him who, after the killing, is having authority to cast to the gehenna; yes, I say to you, Fear ye Him.
translations.web: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

translations.kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
translations.ylt: `Are not five sparrows sold for two assars? and one of them is not forgotten before God,
translations.web: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

translations.kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
translations.ylt: but even the hairs of your head have been all numbered; therefore fear ye not, than many sparrows ye are of more value.
translations.web: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

translations.kjv: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
translations.ylt: `And I say to you, Every one--whoever may confess with me before men, the Son of Man also shall confess with him before the messengers of God,
translations.web: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

translations.kjv: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
translations.ylt: and he who hath denied me before men, shall be denied before the messengers of God,
translations.web: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

translations.kjv: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
translations.ylt: and every one whoever shall say a word to the Son of Man, it shall be forgiven to him, but to him who to the Holy Spirit did speak evil, it shall not be forgiven.
translations.web: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
