translations.ylt: but will not rather say to him, Prepare what I may sup, and having girded thyself about, minister to me, till I eat and drink, and after these things thou shalt eat and drink?
translations.web: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

translations.kjv: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
translations.ylt: Hath he favour to that servant because he did the things directed? I think not.
translations.web: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

translations.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
translations.ylt: `So also ye, when ye may have done all the things directed you, say--We are unprofitable servants, because that which we owed to do--we have done.'
translations.web: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in his going on to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee,
translations.web: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

translations.kjv: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
translations.ylt: and he entering into a certain village, there met him ten leprous men, who stood afar off,
translations.web: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

translations.kjv: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
translations.ylt: and they lifted up the voice, saying, `Jesus, master, deal kindly with us;'
translations.web: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

translations.kjv: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
translations.ylt: and having seen them, he said to them, `Having gone on, shew yourselves to the priests;' and it came to pass, in their going, they were cleansed,
translations.web: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

translations.kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
translations.ylt: and one of them having seen that he was healed did turn back, with a loud voice glorifying God,
translations.web: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

translations.kjv: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
translations.ylt: and he fell upon his face at his feet, giving thanks to him, and he was a Samaritan.
translations.web: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said, `Were not the ten cleansed, and the nine--where?
translations.web: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

translations.kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
translations.ylt: There were not found who did turn back to give glory to God, except this alien;'
translations.web: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
translations.ylt: and he said to him, `Having risen, be going on, thy faith hath saved thee.'
translations.web: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

translations.kjv: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
translations.ylt: And having been questioned by the Pharisees, when the reign of God doth come, he answered them, and said, `The reign of God doth not come with observation;
translations.web: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

translations.kjv: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
translations.ylt: nor shall they say, Lo, here; or lo, there; for lo, the reign of God is within you.'
translations.web: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
translations.ylt: And he said unto his disciples, `Days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and ye shall not behold it;
translations.web: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

translations.kjv: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
translations.ylt: and they shall say to you, Lo, here; or lo, there; ye may not go away, nor follow;
translations.web: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

translations.kjv: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
translations.ylt: for as the lightning that is lightening out of the one part under heaven, to the other part under heaven doth shine, so shall be also the Son of Man in his day;
translations.web: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

translations.kjv: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
translations.ylt: and first it behoveth him to suffer many things, and to be rejected by this generation.
translations.web: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

translations.kjv: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
translations.ylt: `And, as it came to pass in the days of Noah, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of Man;
translations.web: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

translations.kjv: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
translations.ylt: they were eating, they were drinking, they were marrying, they were given in marriage, till the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the deluge came, and destroyed all;
translations.web: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

translations.kjv: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
translations.ylt: in like manner also, as it came to pass in the days of Lot; they were eating, they were drinking, they were buying, they were selling, they were planting, they were building;
translations.web: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

translations.kjv: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
translations.ylt: and on the day Lot went forth from Sodom, He rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed all.
translations.web: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

translations.kjv: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
translations.ylt: `According to these things it shall be, in the day the Son of Man is revealed;
translations.web: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

translations.kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
translations.ylt: in that day, he who shall be on the house top, and his vessels in the house, let him not come down to take them away; and he in the field, in like manner, let him not turn backward;
translations.web: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

translations.kjv: Remember Lot’s wife.
translations.ylt: remember the wife of Lot.
translations.web: Remember Lot’s wife!

translations.kjv: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
translations.ylt: Whoever may seek to save his life, shall lose it; and whoever may lose it, shall preserve it.
translations.web: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

translations.kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
translations.ylt: `I say to you, In that night, there shall be two men on one couch, the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left;
translations.web: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

translations.kjv: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
translations.ylt: two women shall be grinding at the same place together, the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left;
translations.web: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

translations.kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
translations.ylt: And they answering say to him, `Where, sir?' and he said to them, `Where the body is, there will the eagles be gathered together.'
translations.web: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

translations.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
translations.ylt: And he spake also a simile to them, that it behoveth us always to pray, and not to faint,
translations.web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

translations.kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
translations.ylt: saying, `A certain judge was in a certain city--God he is not fearing, and man he is not regarding--
translations.web: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

translations.kjv: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
translations.ylt: and a widow was in that city, and she was coming unto him, saying, Do me justice on my opponent,
translations.web: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

translations.kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
translations.ylt: and he would not for a time, but after these things he said in himself, Even if God I do not fear, and man do not regard,
translations.web: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

translations.kjv: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
translations.ylt: yet because this widow doth give me trouble, I will do her justice, lest, perpetually coming, she may plague me.'
translations.web: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

translations.kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
translations.ylt: And the Lord said, `Hear ye what the unrighteous judge saith:
translations.web: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

translations.kjv: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
translations.ylt: and shall not God execute the justice to His choice ones, who are crying unto Him day and night--bearing long in regard to them?
translations.web: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

translations.kjv: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
translations.ylt: I say to you, that He will execute the justice to them quickly; but the Son of Man having come, shall he find the faith upon the earth?'
translations.web: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

translations.kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
translations.ylt: And he spake also unto certain who have been trusting in themselves that they were righteous, and have been despising the rest, this simile:
translations.web: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

translations.kjv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
translations.ylt: `Two men went up to the temple to pray, the one a Pharisee, and the other a tax-gatherer;
translations.web: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

translations.kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
translations.ylt: the Pharisee having stood by himself, thus prayed: God, I thank Thee that I am not as the rest of men, rapacious, unrighteous, adulterers, or even as this tax-gatherer;
translations.web: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

translations.kjv: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
translations.ylt: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all things--as many as I possess.
translations.web: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

translations.kjv: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
translations.ylt: `And the tax-gatherer, having stood afar off, would not even the eyes lift up to the heaven, but was smiting on his breast, saying, God be propitious to me--the sinner!
translations.web: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

translations.kjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
translations.ylt: I say to you, this one went down declared righteous, to his house, rather than that one: for every one who is exalting himself shall be humbled, and he who is humbling himself shall be exalted.'
translations.web: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

translations.kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
translations.ylt: And they were bringing near also the babes, that he may touch them, and the disciples having seen did rebuke them,
translations.web: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

translations.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having called them near, said, `Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not, for of such is the reign of God;
translations.web: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
translations.ylt: verily I say to you, Whoever may not receive the reign of God as a little child, may not enter into it.'
translations.web: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

translations.kjv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
translations.ylt: And a certain ruler questioned him, saying, `Good teacher, what having done--shall I inherit life age-during?'
translations.web: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to him, `Why me dost thou call good? no one is good, except One--God;
translations.web: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

translations.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
translations.ylt: the commands thou hast known: Thou mayest not commit adultery, Thou mayest do no murder, Thou mayest not steal, Thou mayest not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.'
translations.web: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

translations.kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
translations.ylt: And he said, `All these I did keep from my youth;'
translations.web: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

translations.kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
translations.ylt: and having heard these things, Jesus said to him, `Yet one thing to thee is lacking; all things--as many as thou hast--sell, and distribute to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven, and come, be following me;'
translations.web: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

translations.kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
translations.ylt: and he, having heard these things, became very sorrowful, for he was exceeding rich.
translations.web: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

translations.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
translations.ylt: And Jesus having seen him become very sorrowful, said, `How hardly shall those having riches enter into the reign of God!
translations.web: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

translations.kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: for it is easier for a camel through the eye of a needle to enter, than for a rich man into the reign of God to enter.'
translations.web: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
translations.ylt: And those who heard, said, `And who is able to be saved?'
translations.web: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

translations.kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
translations.ylt: and he said, `The things impossible with men are possible with God.'
translations.web: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

translations.kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
translations.ylt: And Peter said, `Lo, we left all, and did follow thee;'
translations.web: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `Verily I say to you, that there is not one who left house, or parents, or brothers, or wife, or children, for the sake of the reign of God,
translations.web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

translations.kjv: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
translations.ylt: who may not receive back manifold more in this time, and in the coming age, life age-during.'
translations.web: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

translations.kjv: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
translations.ylt: And having taken the twelve aside, he said unto them, `Lo, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things shall be completed--that have been written through the prophets--to the Son of Man,
translations.web: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

translations.kjv: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
translations.ylt: for he shall be delivered up to the nations, and shall be mocked, and insulted, and spit upon,
translations.web: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

translations.kjv: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
translations.ylt: and having scourged they shall put him to death, and on the third day he shall rise again.'
translations.web: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

translations.kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
translations.ylt: And they none of these things understood, and this saying was hid from them, and they were not knowing the things said.
translations.web: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in his coming nigh to Jericho, a certain blind man was sitting beside the way begging,
translations.web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

translations.kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
translations.ylt: and having heard a multitude going by, he was inquiring what this may be,
translations.web: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

translations.kjv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
translations.ylt: and they brought him word that Jesus the Nazarene doth pass by,
translations.web: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

translations.kjv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
translations.ylt: and he cried out, saying, `Jesus, Son of David, deal kindly with me;'
translations.web: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

translations.kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
translations.ylt: and those going before were rebuking him, that he might be silent, but he was much more crying out, `Son of David, deal kindly with me.'
translations.web: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

translations.kjv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
translations.ylt: And Jesus having stood, commanded him to be brought unto him, and he having come nigh, he questioned him,
translations.web: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

translations.kjv: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
translations.ylt: saying, `What wilt thou I shall do to thee?' and he said, `Sir, that I may receive sight.'
translations.web: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to him, `Receive thy sight; thy faith hath saved thee;'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

translations.kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
translations.ylt: and presently he did receive sight, and was following him, glorifying God; and all the people, having seen, did give praise to God.
translations.web: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

translations.kjv: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
translations.ylt: And having entered, he was passing through Jericho,
translations.web: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zaccheus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
translations.ylt: and lo, a man, by name called Zaccheus, and he was a chief tax-gatherer, and he was rich,
translations.web: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

translations.kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
translations.ylt: and he was seeking to see Jesus, who he is, and was not able for the multitude, because in stature he was small,
translations.web: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

translations.kjv: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
translations.ylt: and having run forward before, he went up on a sycamore, that he may see him, because through that way he was about to pass by.
translations.web: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

translations.kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zaccheus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
translations.ylt: And as Jesus came up to the place, having looked up, he saw him, and said unto him, `Zaccheus, having hastened, come down, for to-day in thy house it behoveth me to remain;'
translations.web: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

translations.kjv: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
translations.ylt: and he having hastened did come down, and did receive him rejoicing;
translations.web: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

translations.kjv: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
translations.ylt: and having seen it, they were all murmuring, saying--`With a sinful man he went in to lodge!'
translations.web: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

translations.kjv: And Zaccheus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
translations.ylt: And Zaccheus having stood, said unto the Lord, `Lo, the half of my goods, sir, I give to the poor, and if of any one anything I did take by false accusation, I give back fourfold.'
translations.web: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said unto him--`To-day salvation did come to this house, inasmuch as he also is a son of Abraham;
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

translations.kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
translations.ylt: for the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.'
translations.web: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

translations.kjv: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
translations.ylt: And while they are hearing these things, having added he spake a simile, because of his being nigh to Jerusalem, and of their thinking that the reign of God is about presently to be made manifest.
translations.web: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

translations.kjv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
translations.ylt: He said therefore, `A certain man of birth went on to a far country, to take to himself a kingdom, and to return,
translations.web: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

translations.kjv: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
translations.ylt: and having called ten servants of his own, he gave to them ten pounds, and said unto them, Do business--till I come;
translations.web: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

translations.kjv: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
translations.ylt: and his citizens were hating him, and did send an embassy after him, saying, We do not wish this one to reign over us.
translations.web: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
translations.ylt: `And it came to pass, on his coming back, having taken the kingdom, that he commanded these servants to be called to him, to whom he gave the money, that he might know what any one had done in business.
translations.web: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

translations.kjv: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
translations.ylt: `And the first came near, saying, Sir, thy pound did gain ten pounds;
translations.web: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

translations.kjv: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
translations.ylt: and he said to him, Well done, good servant, because in a very little thou didst become faithful, be having authority over ten cities.
translations.web: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

translations.kjv: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
translations.ylt: `And the second came, saying, Sir, thy pound made five pounds;
translations.web: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

translations.kjv: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
translations.ylt: and he said also to this one, And thou, become thou over five cities.
translations.web: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

translations.kjv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
translations.ylt: `And another came, saying, Sir, lo, thy pound, that I had lying away in a napkin;
translations.web: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

translations.kjv: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
translations.ylt: for I was afraid of thee, because thou art an austere man; thou takest up what thou didst not lay down, and reapest what thou didst not sow.
translations.web: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

translations.kjv: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
translations.ylt: `And he saith to him, Out of thy mouth I will judge thee, evil servant: thou knewest that I am an austere man, taking up what I did not lay down, and reaping what I did not sow!
translations.web: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

translations.kjv: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
translations.ylt: and wherefore didst thou not give my money to the bank, and I, having come, with interest might have received it?
translations.web: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

translations.kjv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
translations.ylt: `And to those standing by he said, Take from him the pound, and give to him having the ten pounds--
translations.web: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

translations.kjv: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
translations.ylt: (and they said to him, Sir, he hath ten pounds) --
translations.web: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

translations.kjv: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
translations.ylt: for I say to you, that to every one having shall be given, and from him not having, also what he hath shall be taken from him,
translations.web: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

translations.kjv: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
translations.ylt: but those my enemies, who did not wish me to reign over them, bring hither and slay before me.'
translations.web: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

translations.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: And having said these things, he went on before, going up to Jerusalem.
translations.web: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, as he came nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, unto the mount called of the Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
translations.web: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

translations.kjv: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
translations.ylt: having said, Go away to the village over-against, in which, entering into, ye shall find a colt bound, on which no one of men did ever sit, having loosed it, bring it;
translations.web: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

translations.kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
translations.ylt: and if any one doth question you, Wherefore do ye loose it? thus ye shall say to him--The Lord hath need of it.'
translations.web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

translations.kjv: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
translations.ylt: And those sent, having gone away, found according as he said to them,
translations.web: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

translations.kjv: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
translations.ylt: and while they are loosing the colt, its owners said unto them, `Why loose ye the colt?'
translations.web: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

translations.kjv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
translations.ylt: and they said, `The Lord hath need of it;'
translations.web: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

translations.kjv: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
translations.ylt: and they brought it unto Jesus, and having cast their garments upon the colt, they did set Jesus upon it.
translations.web: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

translations.kjv: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
translations.ylt: And as he is going, they were spreading their garments in the way,
translations.web: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

translations.kjv: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
translations.ylt: and as he is coming nigh now, at the descent of the mount of the Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began rejoicing to praise God with a great voice for all the mighty works they had seen,
translations.web: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

translations.kjv: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
translations.ylt: saying, `blessed is he who is coming, a king in the name of the Lord; peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.'
translations.web: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

translations.kjv: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
translations.ylt: And certain of the Pharisees from the multitude said unto him, `Teacher, rebuke thy disciples;'
translations.web: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
translations.ylt: and he answering said to them, `I say to you, that, if these shall be silent, the stones will cry out!'
translations.web: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

translations.kjv: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
translations.ylt: And when he came nigh, having seen the city, he wept over it,
translations.web: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

translations.kjv: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
translations.ylt: saying--`If thou didst know, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things for thy peace; but now they were hid from thine eyes.
translations.web: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

translations.kjv: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
translations.ylt: `Because days shall come upon thee, and thine enemies shall cast around thee a rampart, and compass thee round, and press thee on every side,
translations.web: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

translations.kjv: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
translations.ylt: and lay thee low, and thy children within thee, and they shall not leave in thee a stone upon a stone, because thou didst not know the time of thy inspection.'
translations.web: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

translations.kjv: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
translations.ylt: And having entered into the temple, he began to cast forth those selling in it, and those buying,
translations.web: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

translations.kjv: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
translations.ylt: saying to them, `It hath been written, My house is a house of prayer--but ye made it a den of robbers.'
translations.web: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

translations.kjv: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
translations.ylt: And he was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes were seeking to destroy him--also the chiefs of the people--
translations.web: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

translations.kjv: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
translations.ylt: and they were not finding what they shall do, for all the people were hanging on him, hearing him.
translations.web: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, on one of those days, as he is teaching the people in the temple, and proclaiming good news, the chief priests and the scribes, with the elders, came upon him,
translations.web: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

translations.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
translations.ylt: and spake unto him, saying, `Tell us by what authority thou dost these things? or who is he that gave to thee this authority?'
translations.web: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
translations.ylt: And he answering said unto them, `I will question you--I also--one thing, and tell me:
translations.web: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

translations.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
translations.ylt: the baptism of John, from heaven was it, or from men?'
translations.web: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

translations.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
translations.ylt: And they reasoned with themselves, saying--`If we may say, From heaven, he will say, Wherefore, then, did ye not believe him?
translations.web: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

translations.kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
translations.ylt: and if we may say, From men, all the people will stone us, for they are having been persuaded John to be a prophet.'
translations.web: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

translations.kjv: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
translations.ylt: And they answered, that they knew not whence it was,
translations.web: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to them, `Neither do I say to you by what authority I do these things.'
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

translations.kjv: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
translations.ylt: And he began to speak unto the people this simile: `A certain man planted a vineyard, and gave it out to husbandmen, and went abroad for a long time,
translations.web: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

translations.kjv: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
translations.ylt: and at the season he sent unto the husbandmen a servant, that from the fruit of the vineyard they may give to him, but the husbandmen having beat him, did send him away empty.
translations.web: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

translations.kjv: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
translations.ylt: `And he added to send another servant, and they that one also having beaten and dishonoured, did send away empty;
translations.web: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

translations.kjv: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
translations.ylt: and he added to send a third, and this one also, having wounded, they did cast out.
translations.web: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

translations.kjv: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
translations.ylt: `And the owner of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my son--the beloved, perhaps having seen this one, they will do reverence;
translations.web: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

translations.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
translations.ylt: and having seen him, the husbandmen reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir; come, we may kill him, that the inheritance may become ours;
translations.web: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

translations.kjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
translations.ylt: and having cast him outside of the vineyard, they killed him; what, then, shall the owner of the vineyard do to them?
translations.web: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

translations.kjv: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
translations.ylt: He will come, and destroy these husbandmen, and will give the vineyard to others.' And having heard, they said, `Let it not be!'
translations.web: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

translations.kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
translations.ylt: and he, having looked upon them, said, `What, then, is this that hath been written: A stone that the builders rejected--this became head of a corner?
translations.web: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

translations.kjv: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
translations.ylt: every one who hath fallen on that stone shall be broken, and on whom it may fall, it will crush him to pieces.'
translations.web: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

translations.kjv: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
translations.ylt: And the chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him in that hour, and they feared the people, for they knew that against them he spake this simile.
translations.web: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

translations.kjv: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
translations.ylt: And, having watched him, they sent forth liers in wait, feigning themselves to be righteous, that they might take hold of his word, to deliver him up to the rule and to the authority of the governor,
translations.web: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

translations.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
translations.ylt: and they questioned him, saying, `Teacher, we have known that thou dost say and teach rightly, and dost not accept a person, but in truth the way of God dost teach;
translations.web: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

translations.kjv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cesar, or no?
translations.ylt: Is it lawful to us to give tribute to Caesar or not?'
translations.web: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

translations.kjv: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
translations.ylt: And he, having perceived their craftiness, said unto them, `Why me do ye tempt?
translations.web: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

translations.kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cesar’s.
translations.ylt: shew me a denary; of whom hath it an image and superscription?' and they answering said, `Of Caesar:'
translations.web: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cesar the things which be Cesar’s, and unto God the things which be God’s.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `Give back, therefore, the things of Caesar to Caesar, and the things of God to God;'
translations.web: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

translations.kjv: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
translations.ylt: and they were not able to take hold on his saying before the people, and having wondered at his answer, they were silent.
translations.web: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

translations.kjv: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
translations.ylt: And certain of the Sadducees, who are denying that there is a rising again, having come near, questioned him,
translations.web: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

translations.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
translations.ylt: saying, `Teacher, Moses wrote to us, If any one's brother may die, having a wife, and he may die childless--that his brother may take the wife, and may raise up seed to his brother.
translations.web: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

translations.kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
translations.ylt: `There were, then, seven brothers, and the first having taken a wife, died childless,
translations.web: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

translations.kjv: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
translations.ylt: and the second took the wife, and he died childless,
translations.web: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

translations.kjv: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
translations.ylt: and the third took her, and in like manner also the seven--they left not children, and they died;
translations.web: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

translations.kjv: Last of all the woman died also.
translations.ylt: and last of all died also the woman:
translations.web: Afterward the woman also died.

translations.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
translations.ylt: in the rising again, then, of which of them doth she become wife? --for the seven had her as wife.'
translations.web: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `The sons of this age do marry and are given in marriage,
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

translations.kjv: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
translations.ylt: but those accounted worthy to obtain that age, and the rising again that is out of the dead, neither marry, nor are they given in marriage;
translations.web: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

translations.kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
translations.ylt: for neither are they able to die any more--for they are like messengers--and they are sons of God, being sons of the rising again.
translations.web: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

translations.kjv: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
translations.ylt: `And that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the Bush, since he doth call the Lord, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob;
translations.web: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

translations.kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
translations.ylt: and He is not a God of dead men, but of living, for all live to Him.'
translations.web: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

translations.kjv: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
translations.ylt: And certain of the scribes answering said, `Teacher, thou didst say well;'
translations.web: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

translations.kjv: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
translations.ylt: and no more durst they question him anything.
translations.web: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David’s son?
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `How do they say the Christ to be son of David,
translations.web: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

translations.kjv: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
translations.ylt: and David himself saith in the Book of Psalms, The Lord said to my lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
translations.web: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

translations.kjv: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
translations.ylt: till I shall make thine enemies thy footstool;
translations.web: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

translations.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
translations.ylt: David, then, doth call him lord, and how is he his son?'
translations.web: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

translations.kjv: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
translations.ylt: And, all the people hearing, he said to his disciples,
translations.web: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

translations.kjv: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
translations.ylt: `Take heed of the scribes, who are wishing to walk in long robes, and are loving salutations in the markets, and first seats in the synagogues, and first couches in the suppers,
translations.web: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

translations.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
translations.ylt: who devour the houses of the widows, and for a pretence make long prayers, these shall receive more abundant judgment.'
translations.web: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

translations.kjv: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
translations.ylt: And having looked up, he saw those who did cast their gifts to the treasury--rich men,
translations.web: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

translations.kjv: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
translations.ylt: and he saw also a certain poor widow casting there two mites,
translations.web: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

translations.kjv: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
translations.ylt: and he said, `Truly I say to you, that this poor widow did cast in more than all;
translations.web: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

translations.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
translations.ylt: for all these out of their superabundance did cast into the gifts to God, but this one out of her want, all the living that she had, did cast in.'
translations.web: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

translations.kjv: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
translations.ylt: And certain saying about the temple, that with goodly stones and devoted things it hath been adorned, he said,
translations.web: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

translations.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
translations.ylt: `These things that ye behold--days will come, in which there shall not be left a stone upon a stone, that shall not be thrown down.'
translations.web: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

translations.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
translations.ylt: And they questioned him, saying, `Teacher, when, then, shall these things be? and what is the sign when these things may be about to happen?'
translations.web: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

translations.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
translations.ylt: And he said, `See--ye may not be led astray, for many shall come in my name, saying--I am he, and the time hath come nigh; go not on then after them;
translations.web: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

translations.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
translations.ylt: and when ye may hear of wars and uprisings, be not terrified, for it behoveth these things to happen first, but the end is not immediately.'
translations.web: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

translations.kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
translations.ylt: Then said he to them, `Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom,
translations.web: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

translations.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
translations.ylt: great shakings also in every place, and famines, and pestilences, there shall be; fearful things also, and great signs from heaven there shall be;
translations.web: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

translations.kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.
translations.ylt: and before all these, they shall lay on you their hands, and persecute, delivering up to synagogues and prisons, being brought before kings and governors for my name's sake;
translations.web: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

translations.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
translations.ylt: and it shall become to you for a testimony.
translations.web: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

translations.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
translations.ylt: `Settle, then, to your hearts, not to meditate beforehand to reply,
translations.web: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

translations.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
translations.ylt: for I will give to you a mouth and wisdom that all your opposers shall not be able to refute or resist.
translations.web: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

translations.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
translations.ylt: `And ye shall be delivered up also by parents, and brothers, and kindred, and friends, and they shall put of you to death;
translations.web: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

translations.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.
translations.ylt: and ye shall be hated by all because of my name--
translations.web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

translations.kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
translations.ylt: and a hair out of your head shall not perish;
translations.web: And not a hair of your head will perish.

translations.kjv: In your patience possess ye your souls.
translations.ylt: in your patience possess ye your souls.
translations.web: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

translations.kjv: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
translations.ylt: `And when ye may see Jerusalem surrounded by encampments, then know that come nigh did her desolation;
translations.web: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

translations.kjv: Then let them which are in Judea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
translations.ylt: then those in Judea, let them flee to the mountains; and those in her midst, let them depart out; and those in the countries, let them not come in to her;
translations.web: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

translations.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
translations.ylt: because these are days of vengeance, to fulfil all things that have been written.
translations.web: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

translations.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
translations.ylt: `And woe to those with child, and to those giving suck, in those days; for there shall be great distress on the land, and wrath on this people;
translations.web: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

translations.kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
translations.ylt: and they shall fall by the mouth of the sword, and shall be led captive to all the nations, and Jerusalem shall be trodden down by nations, till the times of nations be fulfilled.
translations.web: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

translations.kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
translations.ylt: `And there shall be signs in sun, and moon, and stars, and on the land is distress of nations with perplexity, sea and billow roaring;
translations.web: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

translations.kjv: Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
translations.ylt: men fainting at heart from fear, and expectation of the things coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.
translations.web: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

translations.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
translations.ylt: `And then they shall see the Son of Man, coming in a cloud, with power and much glory;
translations.web: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

translations.kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
translations.ylt: and these things beginning to happen bend yourselves back, and lift up your heads, because your redemption doth draw nigh.'
translations.web: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

translations.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
translations.ylt: And he spake a simile to them: `See the fig-tree, and all the trees,
translations.web: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

translations.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
translations.ylt: when they may now cast forth, having seen, of yourselves ye know that now is the summer nigh;
translations.web: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

translations.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
translations.ylt: so also ye, when ye may see these things happening, ye know that near is the reign of God;
translations.web: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
translations.ylt: verily I say to you--This generation may not pass away till all may have come to pass;
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

translations.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
translations.ylt: the heaven and the earth shall pass away, but my words may not pass away.
translations.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

translations.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
translations.ylt: `And take heed to yourselves, lest your hearts may be weighed down with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and anxieties of life, and suddenly that day may come on you,
translations.web: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

translations.kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
translations.ylt: for as a snare it shall come on all those dwelling on the face of all the land,
translations.web: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

translations.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
translations.ylt: watch ye, then, in every season, praying that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that are about to come to pass, and to stand before the Son of Man.'
translations.web: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

translations.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
translations.ylt: And he was during the days in the temple teaching, and during the nights, going forth, he was lodging at the mount called of Olives;
translations.web: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

translations.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
translations.ylt: and all the people were coming early unto him in the temple to hear him.
translations.web: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

translations.kjv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
translations.ylt: And the feast of the unleavened food was coming nigh, that is called Passover,
translations.web: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

translations.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
translations.ylt: and the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how they may take him up, for they were afraid of the people.
translations.web: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

translations.kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
translations.ylt: And the Adversary entered into Judas, who is surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve,
translations.web: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

translations.kjv: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
translations.ylt: and he, having gone away, spake with the chief priests and the magistrates, how he might deliver him up to them,
translations.web: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

translations.kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
translations.ylt: and they rejoiced, and covenanted to give him money,
translations.web: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

translations.kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
translations.ylt: and he agreed, and was seeking a favourable season to deliver him up to them without tumult.
translations.web: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

translations.kjv: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
translations.ylt: And the day of the unleavened food came, in which it was behoving the passover to be sacrificed,
translations.web: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

translations.kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
translations.ylt: and he sent Peter and John, saying, `Having gone on, prepare to us the passover, that we may eat;'
translations.web: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

translations.kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
translations.ylt: and they said to him, `Where wilt thou that we might prepare?'
