translations.web: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Lo, in your entering into the city, there shall meet you a man, bearing a pitcher of water, follow him to the house where he doth go in,
translations.web: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

translations.kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
translations.ylt: and ye shall say to the master of the house, The Teacher saith to thee, Where is the guest-chamber where the passover with my disciples I may eat?
translations.web: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

translations.kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
translations.ylt: and he shall show you a large upper room furnished, there make ready;'
translations.web: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

translations.kjv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
translations.ylt: and they, having gone away, found as he hath said to them, and they made ready the passover.
translations.web: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

translations.kjv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
translations.ylt: And when the hour come, he reclined (at meat), and the twelve apostles with him,
translations.web: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
translations.ylt: and he said unto them, `With desire I did desire to eat this passover with you before my suffering,
translations.web: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

translations.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: for I say to you, that no more may I eat of it till it may be fulfilled in the reign of God.'
translations.web: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
translations.ylt: And having taken a cup, having given thanks, he said, `Take this and divide to yourselves,
translations.web: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

translations.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
translations.ylt: for I say to you that I may not drink of the produce of the vine till the reign of God may come.'
translations.web: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

translations.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
translations.ylt: And having taken bread, having given thanks, he brake and gave to them, saying, `This is my body, that for you is being given, this do ye--to remembrance of me.'
translations.web: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

translations.kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
translations.ylt: In like manner, also, the cup after the supping, saying, `This cup is the new covenant in my blood, that for you is being poured forth.
translations.web: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

translations.kjv: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
translations.ylt: `But, lo, the hand of him delivering me up is with me on the table,
translations.web: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

translations.kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
translations.ylt: and indeed the Son of Man doth go according to what hath been determined; but woe to that man through whom he is being delivered up.'
translations.web: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

translations.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
translations.ylt: And they began to reason among themselves, who then of them it may be, who is about to do this thing.
translations.web: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

translations.kjv: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
translations.ylt: And there happened also a strife among them--who of them is accounted to be greater.
translations.web: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `The kings of the nations do exercise lordship over them, and those exercising authority upon them are called benefactors;
translations.web: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

translations.kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
translations.ylt: but ye are not so, but he who is greater among you--let him be as the younger; and he who is leading, as he who is ministering;
translations.web: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

translations.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
translations.ylt: for who is greater? he who is reclining (at meat), or he who is ministering? is it not he who is reclining (at meat)? and I--I am in your midst as he who is ministering.
translations.web: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

translations.kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
translations.ylt: `And ye--ye are those who have remained with me in my temptations,
translations.web: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

translations.kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
translations.ylt: and I appoint to you, as my Father did appoint to me, a kingdom,
translations.web: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

translations.kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
translations.ylt: that ye may eat and may drink at my table, in my kingdom, and may sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.'
translations.web: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

translations.kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
translations.ylt: And the Lord said, `Simon, Simon, lo, the Adversary did ask you for himself to sift as the wheat,
translations.web: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

translations.kjv: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
translations.ylt: and I besought for thee, that thy faith may not fail; and thou, when thou didst turn, strengthen thy brethren.'
translations.web: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
translations.ylt: And he said to him, `Sir, with thee I am ready both to prison and to death to go;'
translations.web: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

translations.kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
translations.ylt: and he said, `I say to thee, Peter, a cock shall not crow to-day, before thrice thou mayest disown knowing me.'
translations.web: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `When I sent you without bag, and scrip, and sandals, did ye lack anything?' and they said, `Nothing.'
translations.web: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

translations.kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
translations.ylt: Then said he to them, `But, now, he who is having a bag, let him take it up, and in like manner also a scrip; and he who is not having, let him sell his garment, and buy a sword,
translations.web: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

translations.kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
translations.ylt: for I say to you, that yet this that hath been written it behoveth to be fulfilled in me: And with lawless ones he was reckoned, for also the things concerning me have an end.'
translations.web: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

translations.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
translations.ylt: And they said, `Sir, lo, here are two swords;' and he said to them, `It is sufficient.'
translations.web: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

translations.kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
translations.ylt: And having gone forth, he went on, according to custom, to the mount of the Olives, and his disciples also followed him,
translations.web: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

translations.kjv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
translations.ylt: and having come to the place, he said to them, `Pray ye not to enter into temptation.'
translations.web: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

translations.kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone’s cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
translations.ylt: And he was withdrawn from them, as it were a stone's cast, and having fallen on the knees he was praying,
translations.web: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

translations.kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
translations.ylt: saying, `Father, if Thou be counselling to make this cup pass from me--;but, not my will, but Thine be done.' --
translations.web: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

translations.kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
translations.ylt: And there appeared to him a messenger from heaven strengthening him;
translations.web: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

translations.kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
translations.ylt: and having been in agony, he was more earnestly praying, and his sweat became, as it were, great drops of blood falling upon the ground.
translations.web: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

translations.kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
translations.ylt: And having risen up from the prayer, having come unto the disciples, he found them sleeping from the sorrow,
translations.web: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

translations.kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `Why do ye sleep? having risen, pray that ye may not enter into temptation.'
translations.web: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

translations.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
translations.ylt: And while he is speaking, lo, a multitude, and he who is called Judas, one of the twelve, was coming before them, and he came nigh to Jesus to kiss him,
translations.web: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to him, `Judas, with a kiss the Son of Man dost thou deliver up?'
translations.web: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

translations.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
translations.ylt: And those about him, having seen what was about to be, said to him, `Sir, shall we smite with a sword?'
translations.web: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

translations.kjv: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
translations.ylt: And a certain one of them smote the servant of the chief priest, and took off his right ear,
translations.web: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
translations.ylt: and Jesus answering said, `Suffer ye thus far,' and having touched his ear, he healed him.
translations.web: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

translations.kjv: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to those having come upon him--chief priests, and magistrates of the temple, and elders--`As upon a robber have ye come forth, with swords and sticks?
translations.web: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

translations.kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
translations.ylt: while daily I was with you in the temple, ye did stretch forth no hands against me; but this is your hour and the power of the darkness.'
translations.web: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

translations.kjv: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest’s house. And Peter followed afar off.
translations.ylt: And having taken him, they led and brought him to the house of the chief priest. And Peter was following afar off,
translations.web: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

translations.kjv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
translations.ylt: and they having kindled a fire in the midst of the court, and having sat down together, Peter was sitting in the midst of them,
translations.web: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

translations.kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
translations.ylt: and a certain maid having seen him sitting at the light, and having earnestly looked at him, she said, `And this one was with him!'
translations.web: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

translations.kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
translations.ylt: and he disowned him, saying, `Woman, I have not known him.'
translations.web: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

translations.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
translations.ylt: And after a little, another having seen him, said, `And thou art of them!' and Peter said, `Man, I am not.'
translations.web: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

translations.kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilean.
translations.ylt: And one hour, as it were, having intervened, a certain other was confidently affirming, saying, `Of a truth this one also was with him, for he is also a Galilean;'
translations.web: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

translations.kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
translations.ylt: and Peter said, `Man, I have not known what thou sayest;' and presently, while he is speaking, a cock crew.
translations.web: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

translations.kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
translations.ylt: And the Lord having turned did look on Peter, and Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he said to him--`Before a cock shall crow, thou mayest disown me thrice;'
translations.web: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

translations.kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
translations.ylt: and Peter having gone without, wept bitterly.
translations.web: He went out, and wept bitterly.

translations.kjv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
translations.ylt: And the men who were holding Jesus were mocking him, beating him;
translations.web: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

translations.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
translations.ylt: and having blindfolded him, they were striking him on the face, and were questioning him, saying, `Prophesy who he is who smote thee?'
translations.web: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

translations.kjv: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
translations.ylt: and many other things, speaking evilly, they spake in regard to him.
translations.web: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

translations.kjv: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
translations.ylt: And when it became day there was gathered together the eldership of the people, chief priests also, and scribes, and they led him up to their own sanhedrim,
translations.web: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

translations.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
translations.ylt: saying, `If thou be the Christ, tell us.' And he said to them, `If I may tell you, ye will not believe;
translations.web: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

translations.kjv: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
translations.ylt: and if I also question you, ye will not answer me or send me away;
translations.web: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

translations.kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
translations.ylt: henceforth, there shall be the Son of Man sitting on the right hand of the power of God.'
translations.web: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

translations.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
translations.ylt: And they all said, `Thou, then, art the Son of God?' and he said unto them, `Ye say it, because I am;'
translations.web: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

translations.kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
translations.ylt: and they said, `What need yet have we of testimony? for we ourselves did hear it from his mouth.'
translations.web: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

translations.kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
translations.ylt: And having risen, the whole multitude of them did lead him to Pilate,
translations.web: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

translations.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
translations.ylt: and began to accuse him, saying, `This one we found perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying himself to be Christ a king.'
translations.web: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

translations.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
translations.ylt: And Pilate questioned him, saying, `Thou art the king of the Jews?' and he answering him, said, `Thou dost say it.'
translations.web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

translations.kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
translations.ylt: And Pilate said unto the chief priests, and the multitude, `I find no fault in this man;'
translations.web: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

translations.kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
translations.ylt: and they were the more urgent, saying--`He doth stir up the people, teaching throughout the whole of Judea--having begun from Galilee--unto this place.'
translations.web: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

translations.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilean.
translations.ylt: And Pilate having heard of Galilee, questioned if the man is a Galilean,
translations.web: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

translations.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
translations.ylt: and having known that he is from the jurisdiction of Herod, he sent him back unto Herod, he being also in Jerusalem in those days.
translations.web: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

translations.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
translations.ylt: And Herod having seen Jesus did rejoice exceedingly, for he was wishing for a long time to see him, because of hearing many things about him, and he was hoping some sign to see done by him,
translations.web: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

translations.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
translations.ylt: and was questioning him in many words, and he answered him nothing.
translations.web: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

translations.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
translations.ylt: And the chief priests and the scribes stood vehemently accusing him,
translations.web: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

translations.kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
translations.ylt: and Herod with his soldiers having set him at nought, and having mocked, having put around him gorgeous apparel, did send him back to Pilate,
translations.web: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

translations.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
translations.ylt: and both Pilate and Herod became friends on that day with one another, for they were before at enmity between themselves.
translations.web: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

translations.kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
translations.ylt: And Pilate having called together the chief priests, and the rulers, and the people,
translations.web: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

translations.kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
translations.ylt: said unto them, `Ye brought to me this man as perverting the people, and lo, I before you having examined, found in this man no fault in those things ye bring forward against him;
translations.web: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

translations.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
translations.ylt: no, nor yet Herod, for I sent you back unto him, and lo, nothing worthy of death is having been done by him;
translations.web: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

translations.kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
translations.ylt: having chastised, therefore, I will release him,'
translations.web: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

translations.kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
translations.ylt: and they cried out--the whole multitude--saying, `Away with this one, and release to us Barabbas,'
translations.web: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

translations.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
translations.ylt: who had been, because of a certain sedition made in the city, and murder, cast into prison.
translations.web: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

translations.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
translations.ylt: Pilate again then--wishing to release Jesus--called to them,
translations.web: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

translations.kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
translations.ylt: but they were calling out, saying, `Crucify, crucify him.'
translations.web: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
translations.ylt: And he a third time said unto them, `Why, what evil did he? no cause of death did I find in him; having chastised him, then, I will release him.'
translations.web: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

translations.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
translations.ylt: And they were pressing with loud voices asking him to be crucified, and their voices, and those of the chief priests, were prevailing,
translations.web: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

translations.kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
translations.ylt: and Pilate gave judgment for their request being done,
translations.web: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

translations.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
translations.ylt: and he released him who because of sedition and murder hath been cast into the prison, whom they were asking, and Jesus he gave up to their will.
translations.web: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

translations.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
translations.ylt: And as they led him away, having taken hold on Simon, a certain Cyrenian, coming from the field, they put on him the cross, to bear it behind Jesus.
translations.web: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

translations.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
translations.ylt: And there was following him a great multitude of the people, and of women, who also were beating themselves and lamenting him,
translations.web: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

translations.kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having turned unto them, said, `Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but for yourselves weep ye, and for your children;
translations.web: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

translations.kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
translations.ylt: for, lo, days do come, in which they shall say, Happy the barren, and wombs that did not bare, and paps that did not give suck;
translations.web: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

translations.kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
translations.ylt: then they shall begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us, and to the hills, Cover us; --
translations.web: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

translations.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
translations.ylt: for, if in the green tree they do these things--in the dry what may happen?'
translations.web: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

translations.kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
translations.ylt: And there were also others--two evil-doers--with him, to be put to death;
translations.web: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

translations.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
translations.ylt: and when they came to the place that is called Skull, there they crucified him and the evil-doers, one on the right hand and one on the left.
translations.web: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said, `Father, forgive them, for they have not known what they do;' and parting his garments they cast a lot.
translations.web: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

translations.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
translations.ylt: And the people were standing, looking on, and the rulers also were sneering with them, saying, `Others he saved, let him save himself, if this be the Christ, the choice one of God.'
translations.web: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

translations.kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
translations.ylt: And mocking him also were the soldiers, coming near and offering vinegar to him,
translations.web: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

translations.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
translations.ylt: and saying, `If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.'
translations.web: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

translations.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
translations.ylt: And there was also a superscription written over him, in letters of Greek, and Roman, and Hebrew, `This is the King of the Jews.'
translations.web: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

translations.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
translations.ylt: And one of the evil-doers who were hanged, was speaking evil of him, saying, `If thou be the Christ, save thyself and us.'
translations.web: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

translations.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
translations.ylt: And the other answering, was rebuking him, saying, `Dost thou not even fear God, that thou art in the same judgment?
translations.web: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

translations.kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
translations.ylt: and we indeed righteously, for things worthy of what we did we receive back, but this one did nothing out of place;'
translations.web: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
translations.ylt: and he said to Jesus, `Remember me, lord, when thou mayest come in thy reign;'
translations.web: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to him, `Verily I say to thee, To-day with me thou shalt be in the paradise.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

translations.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
translations.ylt: And it was, as it were, the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land till the ninth hour,
translations.web: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

translations.kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
translations.ylt: and the sun was darkened, and the vail of the sanctuary was rent in the midst,
translations.web: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

translations.kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
translations.ylt: and having cried with a loud voice, Jesus said, `Father, to Thy hands I commit my spirit;' and these things having said, he breathed forth the spirit.
translations.web: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

translations.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
translations.ylt: And the centurion having seen what was done, did glorify God, saying, `Really this man was righteous;'
translations.web: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

translations.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
translations.ylt: and all the multitudes who were come together to this sight, beholding the things that came to pass, smiting their breasts did turn back;
translations.web: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

translations.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
translations.ylt: and all his acquaintances stood afar off, and women who did follow him from Galilee, beholding these things.
translations.web: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
translations.ylt: And lo, a man, by name Joseph, being a counsellor, a man good and righteous,
translations.web: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

translations.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: --he was not consenting to their counsel and deed--from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who also himself was expecting the reign of God,
translations.web: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

translations.kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
translations.ylt: he, having gone near to Pilate, asked the body of Jesus,
translations.web: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

translations.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
translations.ylt: and having taken it down, he wrapped it in fine linen, and placed it in a tomb hewn out, where no one was yet laid.
translations.web: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

translations.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
translations.ylt: And the day was a preparation, and sabbath was approaching,
translations.web: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

translations.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
translations.ylt: and the women also who have come with him out of Galilee having followed after, beheld the tomb, and how his body was placed,
translations.web: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

translations.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
translations.ylt: and having turned back, they made ready spices and ointments, and on the sabbath, indeed, they rested, according to the command.
translations.web: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

translations.kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
translations.ylt: And on the first of the sabbaths, at early dawn, they came to the tomb, bearing the spices they made ready, and certain others with them,
translations.web: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

translations.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
translations.ylt: and they found the stone having been rolled away from the tomb,
translations.web: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

translations.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
translations.ylt: and having gone in, they found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
translations.web: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, while they are perplexed about this, that lo, two men stood by them in glittering apparel,
translations.web: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

translations.kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
translations.ylt: and on their having become afraid, and having inclined the face to the earth, they said to them, `Why do ye seek the living with the dead?
translations.web: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

translations.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
translations.ylt: he is not here, but was raised; remember how he spake to you, being yet in Galilee,
translations.web: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

translations.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
translations.ylt: saying--It behoveth the Son of Man to be delivered up to the hands of sinful men, and to be crucified, and the third day to rise again.'
translations.web: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

translations.kjv: And they remembered his words,
translations.ylt: And they remembered his sayings,
translations.web: They remembered his words,

translations.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
translations.ylt: and having turned back from the tomb told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.
translations.web: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

translations.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
translations.ylt: And it was the Magdalene Mary, and Joanna, and Mary of James, and the other women with them, who told unto the apostles these things,
translations.web: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

translations.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
translations.ylt: and their sayings appeared before them as idle talk, and they were not believing them.
translations.web: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

translations.kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
translations.ylt: And Peter having risen, did run to the tomb, and having stooped down he seeth the linen clothes lying alone, and he went away to his own home, wondering at that which was come to pass.
translations.web: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

translations.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
translations.ylt: And, lo, two of them were going on during that day to a village, distant sixty furlongs from Jerusalem, the name of which is Emmaus,
translations.web: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
translations.ylt: and they were conversing with one another about all these things that have happened.
translations.web: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass in their conversing and reasoning together, that Jesus himself, having come nigh, was going on with them,
translations.web: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

translations.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
translations.ylt: and their eyes were holden so as not to know him,
translations.web: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
translations.ylt: and he said unto them, `What are these words that ye exchange with one another, walking, and ye are sad?'
translations.web: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

translations.kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
translations.ylt: And the one, whose name was Cleopas, answering, said unto him, `Art thou alone such a stranger in Jerusalem, that thou hast not known the things that came to pass in it in these days?'
translations.web: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `What things?' And they said to him, `The things about Jesus of Nazareth, who became a man--a prophet--powerful in deed and word, before God and all the people,
translations.web: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

translations.kjv: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
translations.ylt: how also the chief priests and our rulers did deliver him up to a judgment of death, and crucified him;
translations.web: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

translations.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
translations.ylt: and we were hoping that he it is who is about to redeem Israel, and also with all these things, this third day is passing to-day, since these things happened.
translations.web: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

translations.kjv: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
translations.ylt: `And certain women of ours also astonished us, coming early to the tomb,
translations.web: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

translations.kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
translations.ylt: and not having found his body, they came, saying also to have seen an apparition of messengers, who say he is alive,
translations.web: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

translations.kjv: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
translations.ylt: and certain of those with us went away unto the tomb, and found as even the women said, and him they saw not.'
translations.web: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

translations.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `O inconsiderate and slow in heart, to believe on all that the prophets spake!
translations.web: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

translations.kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
translations.ylt: Was it not behoving the Christ these things to suffer, and to enter into his glory?'
translations.web: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

translations.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
translations.ylt: and having begun from Moses, and from all the prophets, he was expounding to them in all the Writings the things about himself.
translations.web: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

translations.kjv: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
translations.ylt: And they came nigh to the village whither they were going, and he made an appearance of going on further,
translations.web: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

translations.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
translations.ylt: and they constrained him, saying, `Remain with us, for it is toward evening,' and the day did decline, and he went in to remain with them.
translations.web: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in his reclining (at meat) with them, having taken the bread, he blessed, and having broken, he was giving to them,
translations.web: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

translations.kjv: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
translations.ylt: and their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he became unseen by them.
translations.web: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

translations.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
translations.ylt: And they said one to another, `Was not our heart burning within us, as he was speaking to us in the way, and as he was opening up to us the Writings?'
translations.web: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

translations.kjv: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
translations.ylt: And they, having risen up the same hour, turned back to Jerusalem, and found gathered together the eleven, and those with them,
translations.web: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

translations.kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
translations.ylt: saying--`The Lord was raised indeed, and was seen by Simon;'
translations.web: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

translations.kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
translations.ylt: and they were telling the things in the way, and how he was made known to them in the breaking of the bread,
translations.web: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

translations.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
translations.ylt: and as they are speaking these things, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith to them, `Peace--to you;'
translations.web: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

translations.kjv: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
translations.ylt: and being amazed, and becoming affrighted, they were thinking themselves to see a spirit.
translations.web: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Why are ye troubled? and wherefore do reasonings come up in your hearts?
translations.web: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

translations.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
translations.ylt: see my hands and my feet, that I am he; handle me and see, because a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me having.'
translations.web: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

translations.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
translations.ylt: And having said this, he shewed to them the hands and the feet,
translations.web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

translations.kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
translations.ylt: and while they are not believing from the joy, and wondering, he said to them, `Have ye anything here to eat?'
translations.web: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

translations.kjv: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
translations.ylt: and they gave to him part of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb,
translations.web: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

translations.kjv: And he took it, and did eat before them.
translations.ylt: and having taken, he did eat before them,
translations.web: He took them, and ate in front of them.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `These are the words that I spake unto you, being yet with you, that it behoveth to be fulfilled all the things that are written in the Law of Moses, and the Prophets, and the Psalms, about me.'
translations.web: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

translations.kjv: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
translations.ylt: Then opened he up their understanding to understand the Writings,
translations.web: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

translations.kjv: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
translations.ylt: and he said to them--`Thus it hath been written, and thus it was behoving the Christ to suffer, and to rise out of the dead the third day,
translations.web: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

translations.kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: and reformation and remission of sins to be proclaimed in his name to all the nations, beginning from Jerusalem:
translations.web: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.
translations.ylt: and ye--ye are witnesses of these things.
translations.web: You are witnesses of these things.

translations.kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
translations.ylt: `And, lo, I do send the promise of my Father upon you, but ye--abide ye in the city of Jerusalem till ye be clothed with power from on high.'
translations.web: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

translations.kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
translations.ylt: And he led them forth without--unto Bethany, and having lifted up his hands he did bless them,
translations.web: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
translations.ylt: and it came to pass, in his blessing them, he was parted from them, and was borne up to the heaven;
translations.web: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

translations.kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
translations.ylt: and they, having bowed before him, did turn back to Jerusalem with great joy,
translations.web: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

translations.kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
translations.ylt: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
translations.web: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
